\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..de: "Ein herzhaftes Lachen ist Sonnenschein im Haus."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..en: "A good laugh is sunshine in the house."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..es: "Una buena risa es sol dentro de la casa."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..fr: "Un bon rire est un rayon de soleil dans la maison."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..hi: "एक अच्छी हँसी घर में धूप की तरह है।"
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..id: "Tawa yang lepas adalah sinar matahari di dalam rumah."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..it: "Una bella risata è il sole dentro casa."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..ja: 「心地よい笑いは、家の中に差す陽光だ。」
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..pt: "Uma boa risada é sol dentro de casa."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..th: "เสียงหัวเราะดี ๆ คือแสงแดดในบ้าน"
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..tr: "İyi bir kahkaha, evin içindeki güneş ışığıdır."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..vi: "Một tiếng cười vui là ánh nắng trong nhà."
\"A good laugh is sunshine in the house..zh: “灿烂的笑声是屋子里的阳光。”

\"A lot of times people look at the nega.ar: "كثيرًا ما ينظر الناس إلى الجانب السلبي فيما يظنون أنهم لا يقدرون عليه. أنا أنظر دائمًا إلى الجانب الإيجابي فيما أقدر عليه."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.de: "Oft schauen Menschen auf die negative Seite dessen, was sie ihrer Meinung nach nicht können. Ich schaue immer auf die positive Seite dessen, was ich kann."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.en: "A lot of times people look at the negative side of what they feel they can't do. I always look on the positive side of what I can do."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.es: "Muchas veces la gente mira el lado negativo de lo que siente que no puede hacer. Yo siempre miro el lado positivo de lo que sí puedo hacer."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.fr: "Bien souvent, les gens ne regardent que le côté négatif de ce qu'ils croient ne pas pouvoir faire. Moi, je regarde toujours le côté positif de ce que je peux faire."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.hi: "कई बार लोग उस नकारात्मक पक्ष को देखते हैं जो उन्हें लगता है वे नहीं कर सकते। मैं हमेशा उस सकारात्मक पक्ष को देखता हूँ जो मैं कर सकता हूँ।"
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.id: "Sering kali orang melihat sisi negatif dari apa yang mereka rasa tak bisa mereka lakukan. Aku selalu melihat sisi positif dari apa yang bisa kulakukan."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.it: "Molte volte le persone guardano il lato negativo di quello che sentono di non poter fare. Io guardo sempre il lato positivo di quello che posso fare."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.ja: 「多くの人は、自分にはできないと思うことの否定的な面を見る。私はいつも、自分にできることの前向きな面を見る。」
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.ko: "많은 사람들은 자기가 할 수 없다고 느끼는 것의 부정적인 면을 본다. 나는 언제나 내가 할 수 있는 것의 긍정적인 면을 본다."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.pt: "Muitas vezes as pessoas olham para o lado negativo do que sentem que não conseguem fazer. Eu sempre olho para o lado positivo do que eu consigo fazer."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.ru: «Часто люди смотрят на негативную сторону того, чего, как им кажется, они не могут. Я же всегда смотрю на позитивную сторону того, что могу.»
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.th: "หลายครั้งผู้คนมองแต่ด้านลบของสิ่งที่คิดว่าตัวเองทำไม่ได้ ฉันมองด้านบวกของสิ่งที่ฉันทำได้เสมอ"
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.tr: "İnsanlar çoğu zaman yapamayacaklarını düşündükleri şeyin olumsuz yanına bakar. Ben her zaman yapabildiklerimin olumlu yanına bakarım."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.vi: "Nhiều người thường nhìn vào mặt tiêu cực của những gì họ nghĩ mình không làm được. Tôi luôn nhìn mặt tích cực của những gì tôi làm được."
\"A lot of times people look at the nega.zh: “很多时候，人们总是看到自己做不到的消极一面。而我总是看到自己能做的积极的一面。”

\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.de: "Die Einstellung ist eine kleine Sache, die einen GROSSEN Unterschied macht."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.en: "Attitude is a little thing that makes a BIG difference."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.es: "La actitud es una cosa pequeña que hace una GRAN diferencia."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.fr: "L'attitude est un petit rien qui fait une ÉNORME différence."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.hi: "नज़रिया एक छोटी सी चीज़ है, जो बहुत बड़ा फ़र्क़ लाती है।"
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.id: "Sikap adalah hal kecil yang membuat perbedaan BESAR."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.it: "L'atteggiamento è una piccola cosa che fa una GRANDE differenza."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.ja: 「態度は小さなことだが、とても大きな違いを生む。」
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.pt: "Atitude é uma coisa pequena que faz uma GRANDE diferença."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.th: "ทัศนคติเป็นเรื่องเล็ก ๆ ที่สร้างความต่างอย่างมหาศาล"
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.tr: "Tutum, BÜYÜK bir fark yaratan küçük bir şeydir."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.vi: "Thái độ là điều nhỏ bé tạo nên khác biệt LỚN."
\"Attitude is a little thing that makes.zh: “态度是一件小事，却能带来巨大的改变。”

\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.ar: "تغرّد الطيور بعد العاصفة؛ فلماذا لا يشعر الناس بالحرية في الاستمتاع بما تبقّى لهم من ضوء الشمس؟"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.de: "Vögel singen nach dem Sturm; warum sollten Menschen sich nicht ebenso frei fühlen, sich an dem Sonnenlicht zu erfreuen, das ihnen bleibt?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.en: "Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn't people feel as free to delight in whatever sunlight remains to them?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.es: "Los pájaros cantan después de la tormenta; ¿por qué no habría de sentirse la gente libre de disfrutar la luz que le queda?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.fr: "Les oiseaux chantent après l'orage ; pourquoi les gens ne se sentiraient-ils pas libres de se réjouir du soleil qui leur reste ?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.hi: "तूफ़ान के बाद पंछी गाते हैं; तो लोग बची हुई धूप का आनंद लेने में क्यों झिझकें?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.id: "Burung bernyanyi setelah badai; mengapa manusia tak boleh bebas menikmati sisa cahaya matahari yang masih ada?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.it: "Gli uccelli cantano dopo la tempesta: perché le persone non dovrebbero sentirsi libere di gioire della luce che resta loro?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.ja: 「嵐の後、鳥は歌う。ならば人も、残された陽の光を心ゆくまで喜んでよいはずだ。」
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.ko: "폭풍이 지나면 새들이 노래한다. 사람들도 남아 있는 햇빛을 마음껏 즐기지 못할 이유가 무엇인가?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.pt: "Os pássaros cantam depois da tempestade; por que as pessoas não deveriam se sentir livres para se alegrar com a luz do sol que lhes resta?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.ru: «После бури птицы поют — почему же люди не могут свободно радоваться тому солнцу, что у них осталось?»
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.th: "นกยังร้องเพลงหลังพายุผ่านไป แล้วทำไมคนเราจะยินดีกับแสงแดดที่ยังเหลืออยู่ไม่ได้"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.tr: "Kuşlar fırtınadan sonra şarkı söyler; insanlar neden kendilerine kalan güneş ışığının tadını çıkarmakta bu kadar özgür hissetmesin?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.vi: "Chim ca sau cơn bão; vậy sao con người lại không thể thảnh thơi vui với chút nắng còn lại?"
\"Birds sing after a storm; why shouldn'.zh: “暴风雨过后，鸟儿歌唱；为什么人们就不能自由地享受残留的阳光呢？”

\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.ar: "تأتي السحب عابرة إلى حياتي، لا لتحمل المطر أو تجلب العاصفة، بل لتضيف لونًا إلى سماء غروبي."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.de: "Wolken schweben in mein Leben, nicht mehr um Regen zu bringen oder Stürme anzukündigen, sondern um meinem Abendhimmel Farbe zu verleihen."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.en: "Clouds come floating into my life, no longer to carry rain or usher storm, but to add color to my sunset sky."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.es: "Las nubes entran flotando en mi vida, ya no para traer lluvia ni desatar tormentas, sino para dar color al cielo de mi atardecer."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.fr: "Les nuages entrent dans ma vie non plus pour y porter la pluie ou annoncer l'orage, mais pour ajouter des couleurs à mon ciel de couchant."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.hi: "बादल मेरी ज़िंदगी में तैरते चले आते हैं, अब बारिश लाने या तूफ़ान मचाने नहीं, बल्कि मेरे ढलते सूरज के आकाश में रंग भरने।"
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.id: "Awan datang melayang ke dalam hidupku, bukan lagi untuk membawa hujan atau badai, melainkan untuk menambah warna pada langit senjaku."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.it: "Le nuvole entrano fluttuando nella mia vita, non più per portare pioggia o scatenare tempeste, ma per aggiungere colore al cielo del mio tramonto."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.ja: 「雲が私の人生に流れ込む。もう雨を運ぶためでも嵐を呼ぶためでもなく、私の夕暮れの空に彩りを添えるために。」
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.ko: "구름이 내 삶으로 흘러든다. 이제는 비를 뿌리거나 폭풍을 부르기 위해서가 아니라, 내 노을빛 하늘에 색을 더하기 위해서."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.pt: "As nuvens entram flutuando na minha vida, não mais para trazer chuva ou anunciar tempestade, mas para dar cor ao céu do meu poente."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.ru: «Облака вплывают в мою жизнь не для того, чтобы принести дождь или бурю, а чтобы добавить краски моему закатному небу.»
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.th: "เมฆลอยเข้ามาในชีวิตฉัน ไม่ได้พาฝนหรือนำพายุมาอีกแล้ว แต่มาเติมสีให้ฟ้ายามอาทิตย์อัสดง"
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.tr: "Bulutlar hayatıma süzülerek geliyor; artık yağmur taşımak ya da fırtına getirmek için değil, gün batımı gökyüzüme renk katmak için."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.vi: "Những đám mây trôi vào đời tôi, không còn mang mưa hay bão, mà để thêm sắc màu cho trời chiều của tôi."
\"Clouds come floating into my life, no.zh: “云朵飘进我的生活，不再带来雨水或引发风暴，而是给我的夕阳天空增添色彩。”

\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.ar: "الشجاعة لا تزأر دائمًا. أحيانًا تكون الشجاعة ذلك الصوت الخفيض في نهاية اليوم الذي يقول: 'سأحاول مرة أخرى غدًا'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.de: "Mut brüllt nicht immer. Manchmal ist Mut die leise Stimme am Ende des Tages, die sagt: 'Morgen versuche ich es wieder'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.en: "Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the little voice at the end of the day that says 'I'll try again tomorrow'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.es: "El valor no siempre ruge. A veces el valor es esa vocecita al final del día que dice 'mañana lo intentaré de nuevo'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.fr: "Le courage ne rugit pas toujours. Parfois, le courage est cette petite voix qui, en fin de journée, dit 'je réessaierai demain'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.hi: "हिम्मत हमेशा दहाड़ती नहीं। कभी हिम्मत दिन के आख़िर में उठने वाली वह धीमी आवाज़ होती है जो कहती है, 'कल मैं फिर कोशिश करूँगा'।"
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.id: "Keberanian tak selalu mengaum. Kadang keberanian adalah suara kecil di penghujung hari yang berkata 'Besok aku akan mencoba lagi'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.it: "Il coraggio non sempre ruggisce. A volte il coraggio è quella vocina a fine giornata che dice 'domani riprovo'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.ja: 「勇気はいつも吠えるわけではない。時に勇気とは、一日の終わりに『明日また挑戦しよう』とつぶやく小さな声だ。」
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.ko: "용기는 언제나 포효하지 않는다. 때로 용기는 하루가 끝날 무렵 '내일 다시 해보자'라고 말하는 작은 목소리다."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.pt: "A coragem não ruge sempre. Às vezes, a coragem é aquela vozinha no fim do dia que diz: 'Amanhã eu tento de novo'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.ru: «Мужество не всегда рычит. Иногда мужество — это тихий голос в конце дня, который говорит: „Завтра я попробую снова“.»
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.th: "ความกล้าไม่ได้คำรามเสมอ บางครั้งความกล้าคือเสียงเบา ๆ ตอนปลายวันที่บอกว่า 'พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะลองอีกครั้ง'"
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.tr: "Cesaret her zaman kükremez. Bazen cesaret, günün sonunda 'yarın yine denerim' diyen o küçük sestir."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.vi: "Lòng dũng cảm không phải lúc nào cũng gầm vang. Đôi khi dũng cảm là tiếng nói nhỏ cuối ngày rằng 'mai mình sẽ thử lại'."
\"Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes.zh: “勇气并非总是咆哮。有时勇气是一天结束时那个小小的声音，说着"明天我会再试一次"。”

\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.ar: "الشجاعة هي مقاومة الخوف والسيطرة عليه، لا غياب الخوف."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.de: "Mut ist Widerstand gegen die Angst, Beherrschung der Angst, nicht Abwesenheit der Angst."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.en: "Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.es: "El valor es resistencia al miedo, dominio del miedo, no ausencia de miedo."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.fr: "Le courage, c'est résister à la peur, maîtriser la peur, non pas l'absence de peur."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.hi: "हिम्मत डर का सामना करना और उस पर काबू पाना है, डर का न होना नहीं।"
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.id: "Keberanian adalah melawan rasa takut, menguasai rasa takut, bukan tanpa rasa takut."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.it: "Il coraggio è resistenza alla paura, dominio della paura, non assenza di paura."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.ja: 「勇気とは恐怖への抵抗であり、恐怖の克服である。恐怖がないことではない。」
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.ko: "용기란 두려움에 저항하고 두려움을 다스리는 것이며, 두려움이 없는 상태가 아니다."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.pt: "Coragem é resistência ao medo, domínio do medo, não ausência de medo."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.ru: «Мужество — это сопротивление страху и власть над страхом, а не отсутствие страха.»
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.th: "ความกล้าคือการต้านความกลัว การเอาชนะความกลัว ไม่ใช่การไม่มีความกลัว"
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.tr: "Cesaret, korkuya direnmek ve korkuya hakim olmaktır; korkunun yokluğu değil."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.vi: "Dũng cảm là chống lại sợ hãi, làm chủ sợ hãi, chứ không phải không có sợ hãi."
\"Courage is resistance to fear, mastery.zh: “勇气是抵抗恐惧、控制恐惧，而不是没有恐惧。”

\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.ar: "الظلام لا يطرد الظلام، النور وحده يفعل ذلك. والكراهية لا تطرد الكراهية، الحب وحده يفعل ذلك."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.de: "Dunkelheit kann Dunkelheit nicht vertreiben; das kann nur das Licht. Hass kann Hass nicht vertreiben; das kann nur die Liebe."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.en: "Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.es: "La oscuridad no puede expulsar la oscuridad; solo la luz puede hacerlo. El odio no puede expulsar el odio; solo el amor puede hacerlo."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.fr: "Les ténèbres ne peuvent chasser les ténèbres ; seule la lumière peut le faire. La haine ne peut chasser la haine ; seul l'amour peut le faire."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.hi: "अंधकार अंधकार को दूर नहीं कर सकता; यह केवल प्रकाश कर सकता है। नफ़रत नफ़रत को नहीं मिटा सकती; यह केवल प्रेम कर सकता है।"
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.id: "Kegelapan tak bisa mengusir kegelapan; hanya cahaya yang bisa. Kebencian tak bisa mengusir kebencian; hanya cinta yang bisa."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.it: "Le tenebre non possono scacciare le tenebre: solo la luce può farlo. L'odio non può scacciare l'odio: solo l'amore può farlo."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.ja: 「暗闇は暗闇を追い払えない。それができるのは光だけだ。憎しみは憎しみを追い払えない。それができるのは愛だけだ。」
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.ko: "어둠은 어둠을 몰아낼 수 없다. 오직 빛만이 그렇게 할 수 있다. 증오는 증오를 몰아낼 수 없다. 오직 사랑만이 그렇게 할 수 있다."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.pt: "As trevas não podem expulsar as trevas; só a luz pode fazer isso. O ódio não pode expulsar o ódio; só o amor pode fazer isso."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.ru: «Тьму не изгнать тьмой — это может только свет. Ненависть не изгнать ненавистью — это может только любовь.»
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.th: "ความมืดไม่อาจขับไล่ความมืด มีเพียงแสงสว่างที่ทำได้ ความเกลียดชังไม่อาจขับไล่ความเกลียดชัง มีเพียงความรักที่ทำได้"
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.tr: "Karanlık karanlığı kovamaz; bunu ancak ışık yapabilir. Nefret nefreti kovamaz; bunu ancak sevgi yapabilir."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.vi: "Bóng tối không thể xua tan bóng tối; chỉ ánh sáng làm được. Hận thù không thể xua tan hận thù; chỉ tình yêu làm được."
\"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; on.zh: “黑暗无法驱散黑暗，只有光明才能做到。仇恨无法驱散仇恨，只有爱才能做到。”

\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.ar: "لا تعش في الماضي، ولا تحلم بالمستقبل، بل ركّز عقلك على اللحظة الحاضرة."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.de: "Häng nicht in der Vergangenheit, träume nicht von der Zukunft, richte den Geist auf den gegenwärtigen Moment."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.en: "Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.es: "No habites en el pasado, no sueñes con el futuro: concentra la mente en el momento presente."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.fr: "Ne t'attarde pas sur le passé, ne rêve pas de l'avenir, concentre ton esprit sur l'instant présent."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.hi: "अतीत में मत उलझो, भविष्य के सपने मत देखो, मन को वर्तमान क्षण पर केंद्रित करो।"
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.id: "Jangan terpaku pada masa lalu, jangan berangan-angan tentang masa depan, pusatkan pikiran pada saat ini."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.it: "Non vivere nel passato, non sognare il futuro: concentra la mente sul momento presente."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.ja: 「過去にとらわれず、未来を夢見ず、心を今この瞬間に集中させよ。」
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.ko: "과거에 머물지 말고, 미래를 꿈꾸지 말고, 지금 이 순간에 마음을 집중하라."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.pt: "Não se apegue ao passado, não sonhe com o futuro, concentre a mente no momento presente."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.ru: «Не живите прошлым, не мечтайте о будущем — сосредоточьте разум на настоящем мгновении.»
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.th: "อย่าจมอยู่กับอดีต อย่าเพ้อฝันถึงอนาคต จงรวมใจไว้กับปัจจุบันขณะ"
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.tr: "Geçmişte oyalanma, geleceği hayal etme; zihnini şimdiki ana odakla."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.vi: "Đừng đắm chìm trong quá khứ, đừng mơ về tương lai, hãy tập trung tâm trí vào giây phút hiện tại."
\"Do not dwell in the past, do not dream.zh: “不要沉湎于过去，不要幻想未来，专注于当下。”

\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.ar: "لا تأخذ الحياة بجدية مفرطة، فلن تخرج منها حيًّا على أي حال."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.de: "Nimm das Leben nicht zu ernst. Du kommst sowieso nicht lebend heraus."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.en: "Do not take life too seriously. You will never get out of it alive."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.es: "No te tomes la vida demasiado en serio: de todos modos no saldrás vivo de ella."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.fr: "Ne prends pas la vie trop au sérieux. Tu n'en sortiras jamais vivant."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.hi: "ज़िंदगी को बहुत गंभीरता से न लें। आप इसमें से ज़िंदा बाहर नहीं निकल पाएँगे।"
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.id: "Jangan terlalu serius menjalani hidup. Kau takkan keluar darinya hidup-hidup."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.it: "Non prendere la vita troppo sul serio: non ne uscirai vivo comunque."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.ja: 「人生を深刻に考えすぎてはいけない。どうせ生きたまま抜け出すことはできないのだから。」
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.ko: "삶을 너무 심각하게 여기지 마라. 어차피 살아서 빠져나갈 수는 없다."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.pt: "Não leve a vida muito a sério. Você nunca vai sair dela vivo."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.ru: «Не относитесь к жизни слишком серьёзно — живым из неё всё равно не выбраться.»
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.th: "อย่าจริงจังกับชีวิตมากเกินไป ยังไงคุณก็ไม่ได้ออกไปจากมันแบบเป็น ๆ"
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.tr: "Hayatı fazla ciddiye alma. Ondan asla canlı çıkamayacaksın."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.vi: "Đừng sống quá nghiêm trọng. Bạn sẽ chẳng bao giờ ra khỏi cuộc đời này mà còn sống."
\"Do not take life too seriously. You wi.zh: “不要把生活看得太严肃。你永远无法活着走出它。”

\"Do one thing every day that scares you.de: "Tu jeden Tag eine Sache, die dir Angst macht."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.en: "Do one thing every day that scares you."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.es: "Haz cada día algo que te dé miedo."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.fr: "Fais chaque jour une chose qui te fait peur."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.hi: "रोज़ एक काम ऐसा करें जिससे आपको डर लगता है।"
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.id: "Lakukan satu hal yang menakutkanmu setiap hari."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.it: "Fai ogni giorno una cosa che ti spaventa."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.ja: 「毎日、自分が怖いと思うことを一つやってみよう。」
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.ko: "매일 당신을 두렵게 하는 일 한 가지를 하라."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.pt: "Faça todos os dias algo que te dê medo."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.ru: «Каждый день делай одно дело, которое тебя пугает.»
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.th: "ทำสิ่งที่ทำให้คุณกลัวหนึ่งอย่างทุกวัน"
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.tr: "Her gün seni korkutan bir şey yap."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.vi: "Mỗi ngày hãy làm một điều khiến bạn e sợ."
\"Do one thing every day that scares you.zh: “每天做一件让你感到害怕的事。”

\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.ar: "افعل ما يخبرك قلبك أنه صحيح — فستُنتقد على أي حال."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.de: "Tu, was du in deinem Herzen für richtig hältst - kritisiert wirst du ohnehin."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.en: "Do what you feel in your heart to be right - for you'll be criticized anyway."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.es: "Haz lo que en tu corazón sientas que es correcto: de todos modos te van a criticar."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.fr: "Fais ce que ton cœur juge juste - de toute façon, on te critiquera."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.hi: "जो आपका दिल सही कहे वही करें — आलोचना तो आपकी हर हाल में होगी।"
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.id: "Lakukan apa yang hatimu rasa benar - karena kau akan tetap dikritik."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.it: "Fai ciò che nel tuo cuore senti essere giusto: verrai criticato comunque."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.ja: 「心から正しいと思うことをしよう。どうせ批判はされるのだから。」
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.ko: "마음속으로 옳다고 느끼는 일을 하라. 어차피 비판은 받게 된다."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.pt: "Faça o que seu coração sente ser certo - você vai ser criticado de qualquer forma."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.ru: «Делай то, что сердцем считаешь правильным, — критиковать тебя будут всё равно.»
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.th: "ทำสิ่งที่ใจคุณรู้ว่าถูกต้อง - เพราะยังไงก็จะมีคนวิจารณ์อยู่ดี"
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.tr: "Kalbinde doğru olduğunu hissettiğin şeyi yap - nasılsa eleştirileceksin."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.vi: "Hãy làm điều mà trái tim bạn cho là đúng - vì dù sao bạn cũng sẽ bị chỉ trích."
\"Do what you feel in your heart to be r.zh: “做你内心认为正确的事——反正你都会被批评。”

\"Don't go through life, grow through li.ar: "لا تمرّ بالحياة مرورًا، بل انمُ بها."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.de: "Geh nicht durch das Leben, wachse durch das Leben."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.en: "Don't go through life, grow through life."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.es: "No atravieses la vida: crece a través de la vida."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.fr: "Ne traverse pas la vie, grandis à travers elle."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.hi: "ज़िंदगी को बस गुज़ारो मत, ज़िंदगी के साथ बढ़ो।"
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.id: "Jangan hanya menjalani hidup, tumbuhlah lewat hidup."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.it: "Non attraversare la vita: cresci attraverso la vita."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.ja: 「人生をただ通り過ぎるのではなく、人生を通して成長しよう。」
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.ko: "삶을 그저 지나치지 말고, 삶을 통해 자라나라."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.pt: "Não atravesse a vida; cresça através da vida."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.ru: «Не просто проходи сквозь жизнь — расти сквозь жизнь.»
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.th: "อย่าเพียงผ่านชีวิตไป จงเติบโตไปกับชีวิต"
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.tr: "Hayatın içinden geçip gitme, hayatla birlikte büyü."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.vi: "Đừng chỉ đi qua cuộc đời, hãy trưởng thành qua cuộc đời."
\"Don't go through life, grow through li.zh: “不要经历生活，而要通过生活来成长。”

\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.ar: "لكل شيء عجائبه، حتى الظلام والصمت، وقد تعلمت أن أكون راضية بأي حال أكون فيه."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.de: "Alles hat seine Wunder, selbst Dunkelheit und Stille, und ich lerne, in welchem Zustand ich auch bin, darin zufrieden zu sein."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.en: "Everything has its wonders, even darkness and silence, and I learn, whatever state I may be in, therein to be content."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.es: "Todo tiene sus maravillas, incluso la oscuridad y el silencio, y aprendo a estar contenta en cualquier estado en que me encuentre."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.fr: "Tout a ses merveilles, même l'obscurité et le silence, et j'apprends, quel que soit mon état, à m'en contenter."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.hi: "हर चीज़ में अपना कमाल है, अंधकार और मौन में भी; और मैंने सीख लिया है कि मैं जिस भी हाल में रहूँ, उसी में संतुष्ट रहूँ।"
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.id: "Segalanya punya keajaibannya sendiri, bahkan kegelapan dan keheningan, dan aku belajar untuk merasa cukup dalam keadaan apa pun."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.it: "Ogni cosa ha le sue meraviglie, anche il buio e il silenzio, e io imparo, in qualunque stato mi trovi, a esserne contenta."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.ja: 「すべてに素晴らしさがある。暗闇や静寂にさえも。そして私はどんな境遇にあっても、そこで満ち足りることを学ぶ。」
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.ko: "모든 것에는 놀라움이 있다. 어둠과 침묵조차도. 그리고 나는 어떤 처지에 있든 그 안에서 만족하는 법을 배운다."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.pt: "Tudo tem suas maravilhas, até a escuridão e o silêncio, e eu aprendo, em qualquer estado em que esteja, a me contentar nele."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.ru: «Во всём есть свои чудеса — даже в темноте и тишине; и я учусь быть довольной в любом состоянии, в котором оказываюсь.»
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.th: "ทุกสิ่งมีความน่าอัศจรรย์ของมัน แม้แต่ความมืดและความเงียบ และฉันเรียนรู้ว่า ไม่ว่าจะอยู่ในสภาพใด ก็พอใจในสภาพนั้นได้"
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.tr: "Her şeyin kendi harikaları vardır, karanlığın ve sessizliğin bile; ve hangi durumda olursam olayım, onda yetinmeyi öğreniyorum."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.vi: "Mọi thứ đều có điều kỳ diệu, kể cả bóng tối và tĩnh lặng, và tôi học được rằng ở hoàn cảnh nào cũng hãy bằng lòng."
\"Everything has its wonders, even darkn.zh: “一切都有其奇妙之处，甚至黑暗和寂静，我学会了，无论处于何种状态，都要心存满足。”

\"Focus on being productive instead of b.ar: "ركّز على أن تكون منتجًا لا مشغولًا."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.de: "Konzentriere dich darauf, produktiv zu sein, statt beschäftigt."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.en: "Focus on being productive instead of busy."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.es: "Concéntrate en ser productivo, no en estar ocupado."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.hi: "व्यस्त दिखने की जगह उपयोगी होने पर ध्यान दें।"
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.ja: 「忙しくなることではなく、成果を生むことに集中しよう。」
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.ko: "바쁜 사람이 아니라 생산적인 사람이 되는 데 집중하라."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.pt: "Concentre-se em ser produtivo, não em ser ocupado."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.th: "มุ่งไปที่การทำงานให้ได้ผล ไม่ใช่การยุ่งไปวัน ๆ"
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.vi: "Hãy tập trung để làm việc hiệu quả, chứ không phải để bận rộn."
\"Focus on being productive instead of b.zh: “专注于提高生产力，而不是让自己忙碌。”

\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.ar: "السعادة تنمو عند مواقدنا، ولا تُقطف في حدائق الغرباء."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.de: "Das Glück wächst an unserem eigenen Herdfeuer und lässt sich nicht in fremden Gärten pflücken."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.en: "Happiness grows at our own firesides, and is not to be picked in strangers' gardens."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.es: "La felicidad crece junto a nuestro propio hogar y no se recoge en jardines ajenos."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.fr: "Le bonheur pousse à notre propre foyer, il ne se cueille pas dans le jardin des étrangers."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.hi: "खुशी हमारे ही घर के चूल्हे के पास उगती है, इसे अजनबियों के बगीचों से नहीं तोड़ा जा सकता।"
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.id: "Kebahagiaan tumbuh di tungku rumah kita sendiri, bukan untuk dipetik di taman orang lain."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.it: "La felicità cresce accanto al nostro focolare e non si raccoglie nei giardini degli estranei."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.ja: 「幸福は自分の炉辺で育つもので、他人の庭で摘み取るものではない。」
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.ko: "행복은 우리 집 난롯가에서 자라며, 낯선 이의 정원에서 딸 수 있는 것이 아니다."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.pt: "A felicidade cresce junto à nossa própria lareira e não se colhe em jardins alheios."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.ru: «Счастье растёт у нашего собственного очага, его не сорвать в чужих садах.»
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.th: "ความสุขงอกงามอยู่ข้างเตาไฟของเราเอง ไม่ใช่สิ่งที่เก็บได้จากสวนของคนแปลกหน้า"
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.tr: "Mutluluk kendi ocağımızın başında büyür; yabancıların bahçelerinde toplanmaz."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.vi: "Hạnh phúc nảy mầm bên bếp lửa nhà ta, chứ không phải hái được trong vườn người lạ."
\"Happiness grows at our own firesides,.zh: “幸福在我们自己的炉边生长，而不是在陌生人的花园里采摘。”

\"Happiness is not something you postpon.ar: "السعادة ليست شيئًا تؤجله إلى المستقبل؛ إنها شيء تصممه لحاضرك."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.de: "Glück ist nichts, was du auf die Zukunft verschiebst; es ist etwas, das du für die Gegenwart gestaltest."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.en: "Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.es: "La felicidad no es algo que aplazas para el futuro: es algo que diseñas para el presente."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.fr: "Le bonheur n'est pas une chose que tu remets à plus tard ; c'est une chose que tu conçois pour le présent."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.hi: "खुशी वह चीज़ नहीं जिसे आप भविष्य के लिए टाल दें; यह वह चीज़ है जिसे आप वर्तमान के लिए गढ़ते हैं।"
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.id: "Kebahagiaan bukan sesuatu yang kau tunda untuk masa depan; ia sesuatu yang kau rancang untuk saat ini."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.it: "La felicità non è qualcosa che rimandi al futuro: è qualcosa che progetti per il presente."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.ja: 「幸福は未来へ先延ばしするものではなく、今のために設計するものだ。」
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.ko: "행복은 미래로 미루는 것이 아니라, 지금을 위해 설계하는 것이다."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.pt: "A felicidade não é algo que você adia para o futuro; é algo que você projeta para o presente."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.ru: «Счастье — не то, что откладывают на будущее, а то, что создают для настоящего.»
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.th: "ความสุขไม่ใช่สิ่งที่คุณเลื่อนไปไว้ในอนาคต มันคือสิ่งที่คุณออกแบบให้ปัจจุบัน"
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.tr: "Mutluluk geleceğe ertelediğin bir şey değildir; şimdi için tasarladığın bir şeydir."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.vi: "Hạnh phúc không phải điều bạn hoãn lại cho tương lai; đó là điều bạn thiết kế cho hiện tại."
\"Happiness is not something you postpon.zh: “幸福不是你为了未来而推迟的事情，而是你为现在而设计的事情。”

\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.ar: "السعادة لا تكمن في الممتلكات ولا في الذهب، السعادة تسكن في الروح."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.de: "Das Glück wohnt nicht im Besitz und nicht im Gold, das Glück wohnt in der Seele."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.en: "Happiness resides not in possessions, and not in gold, happiness dwells in the soul."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.es: "La felicidad no reside en las posesiones ni en el oro: la felicidad habita en el alma."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.fr: "Le bonheur ne réside pas dans les biens, ni dans l'or ; le bonheur habite dans l'âme."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.hi: "खुशी संपत्ति में नहीं बसती, न ही सोने में; खुशी आत्मा में बसती है।"
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.id: "Kebahagiaan tidak bersemayam pada harta, bukan pula pada emas; kebahagiaan tinggal di dalam jiwa."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.it: "La felicità non risiede nei beni né nell'oro: la felicità dimora nell'anima."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.ja: 「幸福は財産にも黄金にも宿らない。幸福は魂に宿る。」
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.ko: "행복은 소유물에도, 황금에도 있지 않다. 행복은 영혼 속에 머문다."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.pt: "A felicidade não reside nos bens nem no ouro; a felicidade habita na alma."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.ru: «Счастье не в имуществе и не в золоте — счастье живёт в душе.»
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.th: "ความสุขไม่ได้อยู่ในทรัพย์สมบัติ ไม่ได้อยู่ในทองคำ ความสุขอยู่ในจิตใจ"
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.tr: "Mutluluk mülkte değildir, altında da değildir; mutluluk ruhta yaşar."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.vi: "Hạnh phúc không nằm trong của cải, cũng chẳng ở vàng bạc, hạnh phúc trú trong tâm hồn."
\"Happiness resides not in possessions,.zh: “幸福不在于拥有财物，也不在于黄金，幸福存在于心灵之中。”

\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.de: "Sich selbst zu heilen ist mit dem Heilen anderer verbunden."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.en: "Healing yourself is connected with healing others."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.es: "Sanarte a ti mismo está conectado con sanar a los demás."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.fr: "Te guérir toi-même est lié au fait de guérir les autres."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.hi: "खुद को ठीक करना दूसरों को ठीक करने से जुड़ा है।"
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.id: "Menyembuhkan dirimu sendiri terhubung dengan menyembuhkan orang lain."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.it: "Guarire se stessi è legato al guarire gli altri."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.ja: 「自分を癒すことは、他者を癒すことにつながっている。」
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.ko: "자신을 치유하는 일은 다른 사람을 치유하는 일과 이어져 있다."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.pt: "Curar a si mesmo está ligado a curar os outros."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.th: "การเยียวยาตัวเองเชื่อมโยงกับการเยียวยาผู้อื่น"
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.vi: "Chữa lành chính mình gắn liền với việc chữa lành người khác."
\"Healing yourself is connected with hea.zh: “治愈自己与治愈他人是相互联系的。”

\"I can't change the direction of the wi.ar: "لا أستطيع تغيير اتجاه الريح، لكني أستطيع تعديل أشرعتي لأصل دائمًا إلى هدفي."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.de: "Ich kann die Richtung des Windes nicht ändern, aber ich kann meine Segel so setzen, dass ich immer mein Ziel erreiche."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.en: "I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.es: "No puedo cambiar la dirección del viento, pero puedo ajustar mis velas para llegar siempre a mi destino."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.fr: "Je ne peux pas changer la direction du vent, mais je peux ajuster mes voiles pour toujours atteindre ma destination."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.hi: "मैं हवा की दिशा नहीं बदल सकता, लेकिन अपनी पाल ऐसी सजा सकता हूँ कि हमेशा अपनी मंज़िल तक पहुँच जाऊँ।"
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.id: "Aku tak bisa mengubah arah angin, tapi aku bisa menyesuaikan layarku agar selalu mencapai tujuan."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.it: "Non posso cambiare la direzione del vento, ma posso regolare le vele per arrivare sempre a destinazione."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.ja: 「風向きは変えられないが、帆を調整すればいつでも目的地にたどり着ける。」
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.ko: "바람의 방향은 바꿀 수 없지만, 돛을 조절해 언제나 목적지에 닿을 수 있다."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.pt: "Não posso mudar a direção do vento, mas posso ajustar minhas velas para sempre chegar ao meu destino."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.ru: «Я не могу изменить направление ветра, но могу настроить паруса, чтобы всегда добираться до цели.»
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.th: "ฉันเปลี่ยนทิศทางลมไม่ได้ แต่ปรับใบเรือได้ เพื่อไปถึงจุดหมายเสมอ"
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.tr: "Rüzgarın yönünü değiştiremem, ama hedefime ulaşmak için yelkenlerimi her zaman ayarlayabilirim."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.vi: "Tôi không đổi được hướng gió, nhưng tôi có thể điều chỉnh cánh buồm để luôn đến được đích của mình."
\"I can't change the direction of the wi.zh: “我无法改变风向，但我可以调整我的船帆，以便始终到达目的地。”

\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.ar: "لا أستطيع أن أمنحك وصفة مضمونة للنجاح، لكني أستطيع أن أمنحك وصفة للفشل: أن تحاول إرضاء الجميع في كل وقت."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.de: "Ich kann dir kein sicheres Rezept für Erfolg geben, aber ein Rezept für Misserfolg: versuche, immer alle zufriedenzustellen."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.en: "I can't give you a surefire formula for success, but I can give you a formula for failure: try to please everybody all the time."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.es: "No puedo darte una fórmula segura para el éxito, pero sí una para el fracaso: intenta complacer a todos todo el tiempo."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.fr: "Je ne peux pas te donner de formule infaillible pour réussir, mais je peux t'en donner une pour échouer : essayer de plaire à tout le monde tout le temps."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.hi: "मैं आपको सफलता का पक्का फ़ॉर्मूला नहीं दे सकता, लेकिन नाकामी का फ़ॉर्मूला दे सकता हूँ: हर वक़्त हर किसी को खुश करने की कोशिश करें।"
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.id: "Aku tak bisa memberimu formula pasti untuk sukses, tapi aku bisa memberimu formula kegagalan: berusaha menyenangkan semua orang sepanjang waktu."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.it: "Non posso darti una formula sicura per il successo, ma posso darti una formula per il fallimento: cerca di piacere a tutti, sempre."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.ja: 「成功の確かな方法は教えられないが、失敗の方法なら教えられる。いつも全員を喜ばせようとすることだ。」
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.ko: "성공의 확실한 공식은 알려줄 수 없지만, 실패의 공식은 알려줄 수 있다. 언제나 모두를 만족시키려 애쓰는 것이다."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.pt: "Não posso te dar uma fórmula infalível para o sucesso, mas posso te dar uma fórmula para o fracasso: tente agradar a todos, todo o tempo."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.ru: «Я не могу дать вам верную формулу успеха, но могу дать формулу провала: пытайтесь всё время угодить всем.»
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.th: "ฉันให้สูตรสำเร็จที่แน่นอนกับคุณไม่ได้ แต่ให้สูตรความล้มเหลวได้ นั่นคือพยายามทำให้ทุกคนพอใจตลอดเวลา"
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.tr: "Sana başarı için kesin bir formül veremem, ama başarısızlık için verebilirim: her zaman herkesi memnun etmeye çalış."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.vi: "Tôi không thể cho bạn công thức chắc thắng, nhưng tôi có thể cho bạn công thức thất bại: cố làm vừa lòng tất cả mọi người."
\"I can't give you a surefire formula fo.zh: “我无法给你一个保证成功的方法，但我可以给你一个失败的公式：试图时时刻刻取悦所有人。”

\"If you change the way you look at thin.ar: "إذا غيّرت طريقة نظرك إلى الأشياء، تغيّرت الأشياء التي تنظر إليها."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.de: "Wenn du die Art änderst, wie du die Dinge betrachtest, ändern sich die Dinge, die du betrachtest."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.en: "If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.es: "Si cambias la forma de mirar las cosas, las cosas que miras cambian."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.fr: "Si tu changes ta façon de voir les choses, les choses que tu regardes changent."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.hi: "अगर आप चीज़ों को देखने का नज़रिया बदल दें, तो जिन चीज़ों को आप देखते हैं वे भी बदल जाती हैं।"
\"If you change the way you look at thin.id: "Jika kau mengubah cara memandang sesuatu, sesuatu yang kau pandang pun ikut berubah."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.it: "Se cambi il modo in cui guardi le cose, le cose che guardi cambiano."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.ja: 「物事の見方を変えれば、見ている物事も変わる。」
\"If you change the way you look at thin.ko: "사물을 보는 방식을 바꾸면, 당신이 보는 사물도 바뀐다."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.pt: "Se você mudar o jeito de olhar as coisas, as coisas que você olha mudam."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.ru: «Измени то, как ты смотришь на вещи, — и вещи, на которые ты смотришь, изменятся.»
\"If you change the way you look at thin.th: "ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนวิธีมองสิ่งต่าง ๆ สิ่งที่คุณมองก็จะเปลี่ยนไป"
\"If you change the way you look at thin.tr: "Bakış açını değiştirirsen, baktığın şeyler de değişir."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.vi: "Nếu bạn thay đổi cách nhìn sự việc, thì sự việc bạn nhìn cũng thay đổi."
\"If you change the way you look at thin.zh: “如果你改变看待事物的方式，你所看待的事物也会改变。”

\"In the end, it's not the years in your.ar: "في النهاية، ليست السنوات في حياتك هي ما يهم، بل الحياة في سنواتك."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.de: "Am Ende zählen nicht die Jahre in deinem Leben, sondern das Leben in deinen Jahren."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.en: "In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.es: "Al final, no cuentan los años de tu vida. Cuenta la vida de tus años."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.fr: "Au bout du compte, ce ne sont pas les années de ta vie qui comptent, mais la vie dans tes années."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.hi: "आख़िर में मायने यह नहीं रखता कि आपके जीवन में कितने वर्ष थे, बल्कि यह कि आपके वर्षों में कितना जीवन था।"
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.id: "Pada akhirnya, yang penting bukan jumlah tahun dalam hidupmu, melainkan kehidupan dalam tahun-tahunmu."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.it: "Alla fine non contano gli anni della tua vita. Conta la vita nei tuoi anni."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.ja: 「最後に大切なのは、生きた年月の長さではなく、その年月に込めた命だ。」
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.ko: "결국 중요한 것은 당신 삶의 세월이 아니라, 그 세월 속에 담긴 삶이다."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.pt: "No fim, não são os anos da sua vida que contam. É a vida dos seus anos."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.ru: «В итоге важны не годы в твоей жизни, а жизнь в твоих годах.»
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.th: "ท้ายที่สุด สิ่งที่สำคัญไม่ใช่จำนวนปีในชีวิตของคุณ แต่เป็นชีวิตในแต่ละปีของคุณ"
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.tr: "Sonunda önemli olan hayatındaki yıllar değil, yıllarındaki hayattır."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.vi: "Cuối cùng, điều đáng kể không phải là số năm bạn sống, mà là sự sống trong những năm ấy."
\"In the end, it's not the years in your.zh: “最终，重要的不是你生命中的岁月，而是你岁月中的生命。”

\"It always seems impossible until it's.de: "Es scheint immer unmöglich, bis es getan ist."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.en: "It always seems impossible until it's done."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.es: "Siempre parece imposible hasta que se logra."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.fr: "Cela semble toujours impossible, jusqu'à ce que ce soit fait."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.hi: "जब तक कोई काम पूरा न हो जाए, वह हमेशा असंभव ही लगता है।"
\"It always seems impossible until it's.id: "Segalanya selalu terasa mustahil sampai akhirnya terwujud."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.it: "Sembra sempre impossibile, finché non è fatto."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.ja: 「成し遂げるまでは、いつも不可能に思えるものだ。」
\"It always seems impossible until it's.pt: "Sempre parece impossível até que seja feito."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.ru: «Всё кажется невозможным, пока не будет сделано.»
\"It always seems impossible until it's.th: "ทุกอย่างดูเป็นไปไม่ได้เสมอ จนกระทั่งมีคนทำมันสำเร็จ"
\"It always seems impossible until it's.tr: "Bir şey yapılana kadar her zaman imkansız görünür."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.vi: "Mọi việc luôn tưởng như bất khả thi cho đến khi nó được hoàn thành."
\"It always seems impossible until it's.zh: “它总是看起来不可能，直到它完成为止。”

\"It's not what happens to you, but how.ar: "ما يهم ليس ما يحدث لك، بل كيف تتفاعل معه."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.de: "Nicht was dir geschieht ist entscheidend, sondern wie du darauf reagierst."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.en: "It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.es: "No importa lo que te sucede, sino cómo reaccionas ante ello."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.fr: "Ce n'est pas ce qui t'arrive qui compte, mais la façon dont tu y réagis."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.hi: "मायने यह नहीं रखता कि आपके साथ क्या होता है, बल्कि यह कि आप उस पर कैसी प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं।"
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.id: "Yang penting bukan apa yang terjadi padamu, melainkan bagaimana kau menanggapinya."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.it: "Non conta ciò che ti accade, ma come reagisci."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.ja: 「大切なのは何が起こるかではなく、それにどう反応するかだ。」
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.ko: "중요한 것은 당신에게 무슨 일이 일어나는지가 아니라, 그것에 어떻게 반응하는지다."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.pt: "Não é o que acontece com você, mas como você reage a isso que importa."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.ru: «Важно не то, что с тобой происходит, а то, как ты на это реагируешь.»
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.th: "สิ่งสำคัญไม่ใช่เรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นกับคุณ แต่เป็นวิธีที่คุณตอบสนองต่อมัน"
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.tr: "Önemli olan sana ne olduğu değil, ona nasıl tepki verdiğindir."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.vi: "Điều quan trọng không phải chuyện gì xảy ra với bạn, mà là bạn phản ứng thế nào."
\"It's not what happens to you, but how.zh: “重要的不是发生在你身上的事情，而是你对此如何反应。”

\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.ar: "أبقِ عينيك على النجوم، وقدميك على الأرض."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.de: "Richte den Blick auf die Sterne und halte die Füße auf dem Boden."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.en: "Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.es: "Mantén los ojos en las estrellas y los pies en la tierra."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.fr: "Garde les yeux vers les étoiles et les pieds sur terre."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.hi: "नज़र सितारों पर रखो और पैर ज़मीन पर।"
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.id: "Tetap tatap bintang, dan tetap berpijak di tanah."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.it: "Tieni gli occhi verso le stelle e i piedi per terra."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.ja: 「目は星に向け、足は地につけよ。」
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.ko: "눈은 별을 향하고, 발은 땅을 딛고 있어라."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.pt: "Mantenha os olhos nas estrelas e os pés no chão."
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.ru: «Смотри на звёзды, но стой ногами на земле.»
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.th: "มองดาวไว้ และวางเท้าให้ติดพื้น"
\"Keep your eyes on the stars, and your.vi: "Hãy hướng mắt lên những vì sao, và đặt chân vững trên mặt đất."

\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.ar: "أبقِ وجهك دائمًا نحو الشمس — وستقع الظلال خلفك."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.de: "Halte dein Gesicht immer der Sonne zu - dann fallen die Schatten hinter dich."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.en: "Keep your face always toward the sunshine - and shadows will fall behind you."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.es: "Mantén siempre el rostro hacia el sol - y las sombras caerán detrás de ti."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.fr: "Garde toujours ton visage tourné vers le soleil - et les ombres tomberont derrière toi."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.hi: "अपना चेहरा हमेशा धूप की ओर रखें — परछाइयाँ आपके पीछे रह जाएँगी।"
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.id: "Hadapkan wajahmu selalu ke arah matahari - dan bayangan akan jatuh di belakangmu."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.it: "Tieni sempre il volto rivolto al sole - e le ombre cadranno dietro di te."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.ja: 「いつも顔を陽の光へ向けていよう。そうすれば影は後ろに落ちる。」
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.ko: "얼굴을 늘 햇빛 쪽으로 향하라. 그러면 그림자는 뒤로 물러난다."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.pt: "Mantenha sempre o rosto voltado para o sol - e as sombras ficarão atrás de você."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.ru: «Всегда поворачивайся лицом к солнцу — и тени останутся позади.»
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.th: "หันหน้าเข้าหาแสงแดดไว้เสมอ - แล้วเงาจะตกอยู่ข้างหลังคุณ"
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.tr: "Yüzünü her zaman güneşe çevir - o zaman gölgeler arkanda kalır."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.vi: "Hãy luôn hướng mặt về phía ánh nắng - và bóng tối sẽ ngả về sau bạn."
\"Keep your face always toward the sunsh.zh: “让你的脸永远朝着阳光——阴影就会落在你身后。”

\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..ar: "المعرفة وحدها لا تكفي، لا بد أن نطبّق. والرغبة وحدها لا تكفي، لا بد أن نفعل."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..de: "Wissen genügt nicht; wir müssen es anwenden. Wollen genügt nicht; wir müssen handeln."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..en: "Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..es: "Saber no basta: hay que aplicar. Querer no basta: hay que hacer."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..fr: "Savoir ne suffit pas, il faut appliquer. Vouloir ne suffit pas, il faut faire."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..hi: "जानना ही काफ़ी नहीं; हमें उसे लागू करना होगा। चाहना ही काफ़ी नहीं; हमें करना होगा।"
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..id: "Mengetahui saja tidak cukup; kita harus menerapkan. Berkeinginan saja tidak cukup; kita harus melakukan."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..it: "Sapere non basta: bisogna applicare. Volere non basta: bisogna fare."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..ja: 「知るだけでは足りない、応用しなければならない。望むだけでは足りない、行動しなければならない。」
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..ko: "아는 것만으로는 충분하지 않다. 적용해야 한다. 의지만으로는 충분하지 않다. 행동해야 한다."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..pt: "Saber não é suficiente; precisamos aplicar. Querer não é suficiente; precisamos fazer."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..ru: «Знать недостаточно — нужно применять. Хотеть недостаточно — нужно делать.»
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..th: "รู้เพียงอย่างเดียวไม่พอ เราต้องนำไปใช้ อยากทำเพียงอย่างเดียวไม่พอ เราต้องลงมือทำ"
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..tr: "Bilmek yeterli değil; uygulamalıyız. İstemek yeterli değil; yapmalıyız."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..vi: "Biết thôi chưa đủ; phải ứng dụng. Muốn thôi chưa đủ; phải hành động."
\"Knowing is not enough; we must apply..zh: “光知道是不够的，我们必须去运用。光有意愿是不够的，我们必须去行动。”

\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.ar: "الحياة 10 بالمئة ما تصنعه منها، و90 بالمئة كيف تتعامل معها."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.de: "Das Leben besteht zu 10 Prozent daraus, was du daraus machst, und zu 90 Prozent daraus, wie du es aufnimmst."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.en: "Life is 10 percent what you make it, and 90 percent how you take it."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.es: "La vida es un 10 por ciento lo que haces con ella y un 90 por ciento cómo la tomas."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.fr: "La vie, c'est 10 pour cent ce que tu en fais et 90 pour cent la façon dont tu le prends."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.hi: "ज़िंदगी 10 प्रतिशत यह है कि आप उसे कैसा बनाते हैं, और 90 प्रतिशत यह कि आप उसे कैसे लेते हैं।"
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.id: "Hidup itu 10 persen tentang apa yang kau buat, dan 90 persen tentang bagaimana kau menyikapinya."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.it: "La vita è per il 10 per cento ciò che ne fai e per il 90 per cento come la prendi."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.ja: 「人生は10パーセントが自分の作るもの、90パーセントがそれをどう受け取るかだ。」
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.ko: "삶은 10퍼센트가 당신이 만드는 것이고, 90퍼센트는 당신이 그것을 받아들이는 방식이다."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.pt: "A vida é 10 por cento o que você faz dela e 90 por cento como você a encara."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.ru: «Жизнь на 10 процентов состоит из того, что вы делаете, и на 90 процентов — из того, как вы это принимаете.»
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.th: "ชีวิต 10 เปอร์เซ็นต์คือสิ่งที่คุณสร้าง อีก 90 เปอร์เซ็นต์คือวิธีที่คุณรับมือ"
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.tr: "Hayat yüzde 10 onu nasıl yaptığın, yüzde 90 onu nasıl karşıladığındır."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.vi: "Cuộc sống là 10 phần trăm những gì bạn tạo ra, và 90 phần trăm cách bạn đón nhận nó."
\"Life is 10 percent what you make it, a.zh: “生活 10% 取决于你如何创造，90% 取决于你如何对待。”

\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.ar: "الحياة مثل قيادة الدراجة: لتحافظ على توازنك، عليك أن تستمر في الحركة."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.de: "Das Leben ist wie Fahrradfahren. Um die Balance zu halten, musst du in Bewegung bleiben."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.en: "Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.es: "La vida es como andar en bicicleta: para mantener el equilibrio, debes seguir avanzando."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.fr: "La vie, c'est comme une bicyclette : pour garder l'équilibre, il faut avancer."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.hi: "ज़िंदगी साइकिल चलाने जैसी है। संतुलन बनाए रखने के लिए आपको चलते रहना होगा।"
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.id: "Hidup itu seperti mengayuh sepeda. Untuk menjaga keseimbangan, kau harus terus bergerak."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.it: "La vita è come andare in bicicletta: per mantenere l'equilibrio devi continuare a muoverti."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.ja: 「人生は自転車に乗るようなもの。バランスを保つには、進み続けるしかない。」
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.ko: "삶은 자전거를 타는 것과 같다. 균형을 잡으려면 계속 나아가야 한다."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.pt: "A vida é como andar de bicicleta. Para manter o equilíbrio, você precisa continuar em movimento."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.ru: «Жизнь похожа на езду на велосипеде: чтобы удержать равновесие, нужно двигаться.»
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.th: "ชีวิตเหมือนการขี่จักรยาน ถ้าอยากทรงตัวอยู่ได้ คุณต้องเคลื่อนไปข้างหน้าเสมอ"
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.tr: "Hayat bisiklete binmek gibidir. Dengeni korumak için hareket etmeye devam etmelisin."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.vi: "Cuộc sống như đi xe đạp. Muốn giữ thăng bằng, bạn phải tiếp tục tiến lên."
\"Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep.zh: “生活就像骑自行车。要保持平衡，你必须不断前进。”

\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.ar: "تتفجر الحياة كنافورة لمن يحفر صخرة الجمود."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.de: "Das Leben sprudelt wie ein Geysir für die, die sich durch den Felsen der Trägheit bohren."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.en: "Life leaps like a geyser for those who drill through the rock of inertia."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.es: "La vida brota como un géiser para quienes perforan la roca de la inercia."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.fr: "La vie jaillit comme un geyser pour ceux qui percent le roc de l'inertie."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.hi: "जो जड़ता की चट्टान को भेद देते हैं, उनके लिए ज़िंदगी फ़व्वारे की तरह उछलती है।"
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.id: "Hidup memancar seperti geyser bagi mereka yang menembus batu kemalasan."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.it: "La vita zampilla come un geyser per chi trapana la roccia dell'inerzia."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.ja: 「惰性という岩を掘り抜く者にとって、人生は間欠泉のように噴き上がる。」
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.ko: "타성의 바위를 뚫는 이에게 삶은 간헐천처럼 솟구친다."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.pt: "A vida jorra como um gêiser para quem perfura a rocha da inércia."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.ru: «Жизнь бьёт гейзером у тех, кто пробивает скалу инерции.»
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.th: "ชีวิตพุ่งขึ้นเหมือนน้ำพุร้อน สำหรับคนที่เจาะทะลุหินแห่งความเฉื่อยชา"
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.tr: "Ataletin kayasını delip geçenler için hayat bir gayzer gibi fışkırır."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.vi: "Cuộc sống vọt lên như mạch nước phun với những ai khoan qua tảng đá trì trệ."
\"Life leaps like a geyser for those who.zh: “对于那些突破惯性岩石的人来说，生活就像喷泉一样跳跃。”

\"Love one another and help others to ri.ar: "أحبوا بعضكم وساعدوا الآخرين على الارتقاء، بمجرد أن تفيضوا حبًا. الحب مُعدٍ، وهو أعظم طاقة شافية."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.de: "Liebt einander und helft anderen, höhere Ebenen zu erreichen, einfach indem ihr Liebe verströmt. Liebe ist ansteckend und die größte heilende Energie."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.en: "Love one another and help others to rise to the higher levels, simply by pouring out love. Love is infectious and the greatest healing energy."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.es: "Ámense unos a otros y ayuden a los demás a elevarse, simplemente derramando amor. El amor es contagioso y es la mayor energía sanadora."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.fr: "Aimez-vous les uns les autres et aidez les autres à s'élever, simplement en répandant l'amour. L'amour est contagieux et c'est la plus grande énergie de guérison."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.hi: "एक-दूसरे से प्रेम करें और सिर्फ़ प्रेम बरसाकर दूसरों को ऊँचा उठने में मदद करें। प्रेम संक्रामक है और सबसे बड़ी उपचार-ऊर्जा है।"
\"Love one another and help others to ri.id: "Saling mencintailah dan bantu orang lain naik ke tingkat yang lebih tinggi, cukup dengan mencurahkan cinta. Cinta itu menular dan merupakan energi penyembuh terbesar."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.it: "Amatevi gli uni gli altri e aiutate gli altri a salire più in alto, semplicemente riversando amore. L'amore è contagioso ed è la più grande energia di guarigione."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.ja: 「互いに愛し合い、ただ愛を注ぐことで人がより高みへ上がる手助けをしよう。愛は伝染し、最も偉大な癒しのエネルギーだ。」
\"Love one another and help others to ri.ko: "서로 사랑하라. 사랑을 쏟아붓는 것만으로도 다른 이들이 더 높은 곳으로 오르도록 도울 수 있다. 사랑은 전염되며, 가장 위대한 치유의 에너지다."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.pt: "Amem-se uns aos outros e ajudem os outros a alcançar níveis mais altos, simplesmente derramando amor. O amor é contagioso e é a maior energia de cura."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.ru: «Любите друг друга и помогайте другим подниматься выше — просто щедро отдавая любовь. Любовь заразительна и это величайшая целительная энергия.»
\"Love one another and help others to ri.th: "รักกันและช่วยให้ผู้อื่นก้าวไปสู่ระดับที่สูงขึ้น เพียงด้วยการหลั่งความรักออกมา ความรักติดต่อกันได้ และเป็นพลังเยียวยาที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุด"
\"Love one another and help others to ri.tr: "Birbirinizi sevin ve sadece sevgi vererek başkalarının daha yüksek seviyelere çıkmasına yardım edin. Sevgi bulaşıcıdır ve en büyük iyileştirici enerjidir."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.vi: "Hãy yêu thương nhau và giúp người khác vươn tới tầm cao hơn, chỉ đơn giản bằng cách trao đi yêu thương. Yêu thương lan truyền và là năng lượng chữa lành lớn nhất."
\"Love one another and help others to ri.zh: “彼此关爱，帮助他人提升到更高的层次，只需倾注爱心即可。爱具有感染力，是最伟大的治愈能量。”

\"Many of life's failures are people who.ar: "كثير من حالات الفشل في الحياة كانت لأشخاص لم يدركوا كم كانوا قريبين من النجاح حين استسلموا."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.de: "Viele Misserfolge im Leben stammen von Menschen, die nicht merkten, wie nah sie am Erfolg waren, als sie aufgaben."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.en: "Many of life's failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.es: "Muchos de los fracasos de la vida son de personas que no se dieron cuenta de lo cerca que estaban del éxito cuando se rindieron."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.fr: "Beaucoup d'échecs dans la vie sont le fait de gens qui n'ont pas réalisé, au moment d'abandonner, à quel point ils étaient proches du succès."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.hi: "ज़िंदगी की कई नाकामियाँ उन लोगों की हैं जिन्हें हार मानते वक़्त पता ही नहीं था कि वे सफलता के कितने करीब थे।"
\"Many of life's failures are people who.id: "Banyak kegagalan dalam hidup dialami orang yang tak menyadari betapa dekatnya mereka dengan sukses saat mereka menyerah."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.it: "Molti dei fallimenti della vita appartengono a chi non si è reso conto di quanto fosse vicino al successo quando ha rinunciato."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.ja: 「人生の失敗の多くは、諦めたときに成功がどれほど近かったかに気づかなかった人たちだ。」
\"Many of life's failures are people who.ko: "인생의 많은 실패는, 포기할 때 자신이 성공에 얼마나 가까웠는지 몰랐던 사람들이다."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.pt: "Muitos dos fracassos da vida são de pessoas que não perceberam o quanto estavam perto do sucesso quando desistiram."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.ru: «Многие неудачники — это люди, которые не понимали, как близко они были к успеху, когда сдались.»
\"Many of life's failures are people who.th: "ความล้มเหลวในชีวิตหลายครั้งเกิดกับคนที่ไม่รู้ว่าตัวเองใกล้ความสำเร็จแค่ไหนตอนที่ยอมแพ้"
\"Many of life's failures are people who.tr: "Hayattaki birçok başarısızlık, vazgeçtiklerinde başarıya ne kadar yakın olduklarını fark etmeyen insanlardır."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.vi: "Nhiều thất bại trong đời thuộc về những người không nhận ra họ đã gần thành công đến mức nào khi bỏ cuộc."
\"Many of life's failures are people who.zh: “生活中的许多失败者，是那些在放弃时没有意识到自己离成功有多近的人。”

\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.ar: "عندما تستبدل الأفكار السلبية بأفكار إيجابية، ستبدأ في الحصول على نتائج إيجابية."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.de: "Sobald du negative Gedanken durch positive ersetzt, wirst du positive Ergebnisse bekommen."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.en: "Once you replace negative thoughts with positive ones, you'll start having positive results."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.es: "Cuando reemplaces los pensamientos negativos por positivos, empezarás a obtener resultados positivos."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.fr: "Dès que tu remplaces les pensées négatives par des pensées positives, tu commences à obtenir des résultats positifs."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.hi: "जैसे ही आप नकारात्मक विचारों की जगह सकारात्मक विचार रख देंगे, आपको सकारात्मक नतीजे मिलने लगेंगे।"
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.id: "Begitu kau mengganti pikiran negatif dengan pikiran positif, kau akan mulai mendapatkan hasil yang positif."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.it: "Quando sostituisci i pensieri negativi con quelli positivi, inizierai ad avere risultati positivi."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.ja: 「否定的な考えを前向きな考えに置き換えれば、前向きな結果が現れ始める。」
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.ko: "부정적인 생각을 긍정적인 생각으로 바꾸면, 긍정적인 결과가 나타나기 시작한다."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.pt: "Quando você substitui os pensamentos negativos por positivos, começa a ter resultados positivos."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.ru: «Как только вы замените негативные мысли позитивными, начнутся и позитивные результаты.»
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.th: "เมื่อคุณเปลี่ยนความคิดลบให้เป็นความคิดบวก ผลลัพธ์ดี ๆ ก็จะเริ่มตามมา"
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.tr: "Olumsuz düşüncelerin yerine olumlu olanları koyduğunda, olumlu sonuçlar almaya başlarsın."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.vi: "Một khi bạn thay ý nghĩ tiêu cực bằng ý nghĩ tích cực, bạn sẽ bắt đầu có kết quả tích cực."
\"Once you replace negative thoughts wit.zh: “一旦你用积极的想法取代消极的想法，你就会开始得到积极的结果。”

\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.ar: "الفرصة لا تقرع الباب، بل تظهر عندما تكسر الباب بنفسك."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.de: "Die Gelegenheit klopft nicht, sie zeigt sich, wenn du die Tür eintrittst."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.en: "Opportunity does not knock, it presents itself when you beat down the door."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.es: "La oportunidad no llama: aparece cuando derribas la puerta."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.fr: "L'occasion ne frappe pas à la porte, elle se présente quand tu enfonces la porte."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.hi: "मौका दस्तक नहीं देता, वह तब सामने आता है जब आप दरवाज़ा तोड़ देते हैं।"
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.id: "Kesempatan tidak mengetuk pintu; ia muncul saat kau mendobrak pintunya."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.it: "L'occasione non bussa: si presenta quando abbatti la porta."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.ja: 「機会はノックしない。あなたが扉を打ち破ったときに現れるのだ。」
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.ko: "기회는 문을 두드리지 않는다. 당신이 문을 두드려 열 때 비로소 나타난다."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.pt: "A oportunidade não bate à porta; ela aparece quando você derruba a porta."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.ru: «Возможность не стучится — она появляется, когда ты сам выбиваешь дверь.»
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.th: "โอกาสไม่มาเคาะประตู มันปรากฏตัวเมื่อคุณทุบประตูเข้าไปเอง"
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.tr: "Fırsat kapıyı çalmaz; sen kapıyı kırıp geçtiğinde kendini gösterir."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.vi: "Cơ hội không gõ cửa, nó xuất hiện khi bạn phá cánh cửa ấy ra."
\"Opportunity does not knock, it present.zh: “机会不会敲门，只有当你敲开门时，机会才会出现。”

\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.ar: "أكبر نقطة ضعف فينا هي الاستسلام. وأضمن طريق للنجاح هو أن تحاول مرة أخرى دائمًا."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.de: "Unsere größte Schwäche liegt im Aufgeben. Der sicherste Weg zum Erfolg ist, es einfach noch einmal zu versuchen."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.en: "Our greatest weakness lies in giving up. The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.es: "Nuestra mayor debilidad es rendirnos. La forma más segura de triunfar es intentarlo una vez más."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.fr: "Notre plus grande faiblesse est d'abandonner. Le moyen le plus sûr de réussir est toujours d'essayer une fois de plus."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.hi: "हमारी सबसे बड़ी कमज़ोरी हार मान लेना है। सफल होने का सबसे पक्का तरीका है — बस एक बार और कोशिश करना।"
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.id: "Kelemahan terbesar kita adalah menyerah. Cara paling pasti untuk berhasil adalah selalu mencoba sekali lagi."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.it: "La nostra debolezza più grande sta nell'arrendersi. Il modo più sicuro di riuscire è provare ancora una volta."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.ja: 「私たちの最大の弱点は諦めることだ。成功への最も確実な道は、もう一度だけ挑戦してみることだ。」
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.ko: "우리의 가장 큰 약점은 포기하는 것이다. 성공에 이르는 가장 확실한 길은 언제나 한 번 더 시도하는 것이다."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.pt: "Nossa maior fraqueza está em desistir. O caminho mais certo para o sucesso é sempre tentar apenas uma vez mais."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.ru: «Наша самая большая слабость — сдаваться. Самый верный путь к успеху — попробовать ещё один раз.»
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.th: "จุดอ่อนที่สุดของเราคือการยอมแพ้ วิธีที่แน่นอนที่สุดในการประสบความสำเร็จคือการลองอีกครั้งเสมอ"
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.tr: "En büyük zayıflığımız vazgeçmekte yatar. Başarmanın en kesin yolu, her zaman bir kez daha denemektir."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.vi: "Điểm yếu lớn nhất của ta là bỏ cuộc. Cách chắc chắn nhất để thành công là thử thêm một lần nữa."
\"Our greatest weakness lies in giving u.zh: “我们最大的弱点在于放弃。最可靠的成功之道永远是再试一次。”

\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.de: "Unser Leben ist die Summe der Entscheidungen, die wir getroffen haben."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.en: "Our lives are a sum total of the choices we have made."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.es: "Nuestras vidas son la suma total de las decisiones que hemos tomado."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.fr: "Nos vies sont la somme des choix que nous avons faits."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.hi: "हमारा जीवन हमारे किए हुए चुनावों का कुल जोड़ है।"
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.id: "Hidup kita adalah jumlah dari semua pilihan yang telah kita buat."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.it: "Le nostre vite sono la somma delle scelte che abbiamo fatto."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.ja: 「私たちの人生は、これまで下してきた選択の総和だ。」
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.pt: "Nossas vidas são a soma total das escolhas que fizemos."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.ru: «Наша жизнь — это сумма сделанных нами выборов.»
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.th: "ชีวิตของเราคือผลรวมของทางเลือกที่เราเคยเลือก"
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.vi: "Cuộc đời ta là tổng hòa của những lựa chọn ta đã thực hiện."
\"Our lives are a sum total of the choic.zh: “我们的生活是我们所做选择的总和。”

\"People will forget what you said and f.ar: "سينسى الناس ما قلته وما فعلته، لكنهم لن ينسوا أبدًا ما جعلتهم يشعرون به."
\"People will forget what you said and f.de: "Die Menschen werden vergessen, was du gesagt hast, und vergessen, was du getan hast, aber sie werden nie vergessen, wie du sie fühlen ließest."
\"People will forget what you said and f.en: "People will forget what you said and forget what you did, but people will never forget how you made them feel."
\"People will forget what you said and f.es: "La gente olvidará lo que dijiste y lo que hiciste, pero nunca olvidará cómo la hiciste sentir."
\"People will forget what you said and f.fr: "Les gens oublieront ce que tu as dit et ce que tu as fait, mais ils n'oublieront jamais ce que tu leur as fait ressentir."
\"People will forget what you said and f.hi: "लोग भूल जाएँगे कि आपने क्या कहा और क्या किया, लेकिन वे यह कभी नहीं भूलेंगे कि आपने उन्हें कैसा महसूस कराया।"
\"People will forget what you said and f.id: "Orang akan lupa apa yang kau katakan dan lupa apa yang kau lakukan, tapi orang takkan pernah lupa bagaimana kau membuat mereka merasa."
\"People will forget what you said and f.it: "Le persone dimenticheranno quello che hai detto e quello che hai fatto, ma non dimenticheranno mai come le hai fatte sentire."
\"People will forget what you said and f.ja: 「人はあなたの言葉を忘れ、あなたの行いも忘れる。だが、あなたに何を感じさせられたかは決して忘れない。」
\"People will forget what you said and f.ko: "사람들은 당신이 한 말도, 당신이 한 일도 잊지만, 당신이 어떤 기분을 느끼게 했는지는 결코 잊지 않는다."
\"People will forget what you said and f.pt: "As pessoas vão esquecer o que você disse e esquecer o que você fez, mas nunca vão esquecer como você as fez sentir."
\"People will forget what you said and f.ru: «Люди забудут, что вы сказали, забудут, что вы сделали, но никогда не забудут, что вы заставили их почувствовать.»
\"People will forget what you said and f.th: "ผู้คนจะลืมสิ่งที่คุณพูดและลืมสิ่งที่คุณทำ แต่จะไม่เคยลืมความรู้สึกที่คุณมอบให้"
\"People will forget what you said and f.tr: "İnsanlar ne söylediğini ve ne yaptığını unutur, ama onlara nasıl hissettirdiğini asla unutmaz."
\"People will forget what you said and f.vi: "Người ta sẽ quên bạn nói gì, quên bạn làm gì, nhưng sẽ không bao giờ quên bạn đã khiến họ cảm thấy thế nào."
\"People will forget what you said and f.zh: “人们会忘记你说过的话，也会忘记你做过的事，但他们永远不会忘记你让他们感受到的情感。”

\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.ar: "الكمال غير قابل للتحقيق، لكن إن سعينا إلى الكمال فقد ندرك التميّز."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.de: "Perfektion ist nicht erreichbar, doch wer der Perfektion nachjagt, kann Spitzenleistung einfangen."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.en: "Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.es: "La perfección no es alcanzable, pero si perseguimos la perfección podemos alcanzar la excelencia."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.fr: "La perfection est inatteignable, mais si nous la poursuivons, nous pouvons atteindre l'excellence."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.hi: "पूर्णता पाई नहीं जा सकती, लेकिन अगर हम पूर्णता का पीछा करें तो उत्कृष्टता पकड़ सकते हैं।"
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.id: "Kesempurnaan tak mungkin dicapai, tapi jika kita mengejar kesempurnaan, kita bisa meraih keunggulan."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.it: "La perfezione non è raggiungibile, ma se inseguiamo la perfezione possiamo afferrare l'eccellenza."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.ja: 「完璧には到達できない。だが完璧を追い求めれば、卓越をつかむことはできる。」
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.ko: "완벽에는 도달할 수 없지만, 완벽을 추구하면 탁월함을 붙잡을 수 있다."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.pt: "A perfeição não é alcançável, mas, se buscamos a perfeição, podemos alcançar a excelência."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.ru: «Совершенство недостижимо, но, стремясь к совершенству, можно достичь мастерства.»
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.th: "ความสมบูรณ์แบบเป็นสิ่งที่ไปไม่ถึง แต่ถ้าเราไล่ตามมัน เราจะคว้าความเป็นเลิศไว้ได้"
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.tr: "Mükemmellik ulaşılabilir değildir, ama mükemmelliğin peşinden koşarsak üstünlüğü yakalayabiliriz."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.vi: "Hoàn hảo là điều không thể đạt được, nhưng nếu theo đuổi hoàn hảo ta sẽ chạm tới sự xuất sắc."
\"Perfection is not attainable, but if w.zh: “完美是无法实现的，但只要我们追求完美，我们就能获得卓越。”

\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.ar: "العب 30 دقيقة كل يوم، وستنام نومًا أفضل وأعمق."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.de: "Spiel täglich 30 Minuten, und du schläfst besser und tiefer."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.en: "Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll sleep better and soundly."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.es: "Juega 30 minutos al día y dormirás mejor y más profundamente."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.fr: "Joue 30 minutes par jour et tu dormiras mieux, d'un sommeil profond."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.hi: "रोज़ 30 मिनट खेलें, आपकी नींद बेहतर और गहरी होगी।"
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.id: "Mainkan 30 menit setiap hari, tidurmu akan lebih nyaman dan lelap."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.it: "Gioca 30 minuti al giorno: dormirai meglio e più profondamente."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.ja: 「毎日30分遊べば、眠りはもっと深く、心地よくなる。」
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.ko: "매일 30분씩 플레이하면 더 깊고 편안하게 잠들 수 있습니다."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.pt: "Jogue 30 minutos por dia e você vai dormir melhor e mais profundamente."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.ru: «Играйте 30 минут в день — и будете спать крепче и слаще.»
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.th: "เล่นวันละ 30 นาที คุณจะหลับสบายและหลับลึกขึ้น"
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.tr: "Her gün 30 dakika oyna; daha iyi ve deliksiz uyursun."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.vi: "Chơi 30 phút mỗi ngày, bạn sẽ ngủ ngon và sâu hơn."
\"Play for 30 minutes daily, you'll slee.zh: “每天玩30分钟，你会睡得更好、更香。”

\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.ar: "المشكلات ليست إشارات توقف، بل هي إرشادات للطريق."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.de: "Probleme sind keine Stoppschilder, sie sind Wegweiser."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.en: "Problems are not stop signs, they are guidelines."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.es: "Los problemas no son señales de alto, son indicaciones del camino."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.fr: "Les problèmes ne sont pas des panneaux d'arrêt, ce sont des repères."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.hi: "समस्याएँ रुकने का इशारा नहीं, राह दिखाने वाले संकेत हैं।"
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.id: "Masalah bukan rambu berhenti, melainkan rambu penunjuk arah."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.it: "I problemi non sono segnali di stop: sono indicazioni."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.ja: 「問題は止まれの標識ではなく、道しるべだ。」
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.pt: "Problemas não são placas de 'pare', são orientações."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.ru: «Проблемы — это не знаки „стоп“, а указатели пути.»
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.th: "ปัญหาไม่ใช่ป้ายหยุด มันคือป้ายบอกทาง"
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.vi: "Khó khăn không phải biển báo dừng, chúng là biển chỉ đường."
\"Problems are not stop signs, they are.zh: “问题不是停止的标志，而是指导方针。”

\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.ar: "تحديد الأهداف هو الخطوة الأولى لتحويل ما لا يُرى إلى واقع مرئي."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.de: "Ziele zu setzen ist der erste Schritt, das Unsichtbare sichtbar zu machen."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.en: "Setting goals is the first step in turning the invisible into the visible."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.es: "Fijar metas es el primer paso para convertir lo invisible en visible."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.fr: "Se fixer des objectifs est le premier pas pour rendre visible l'invisible."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.hi: "लक्ष्य तय करना अदृश्य को दृश्य बनाने का पहला कदम है।"
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.id: "Menetapkan tujuan adalah langkah pertama mengubah yang tak terlihat menjadi nyata."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.it: "Fissare obiettivi è il primo passo per trasformare l'invisibile in visibile."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.ja: 「目標を定めることは、見えないものを見えるものに変える最初の一歩だ。」
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.ko: "목표를 세우는 것은 보이지 않는 것을 보이게 만드는 첫걸음이다."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.pt: "Definir metas é o primeiro passo para transformar o invisível em visível."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.ru: «Поставить цель — первый шаг к превращению невидимого в видимое.»
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.th: "การตั้งเป้าหมายคือก้าวแรกของการเปลี่ยนสิ่งที่มองไม่เห็นให้มองเห็นได้"
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.tr: "Hedef koymak, görünmez olanı görünür kılmanın ilk adımıdır."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.vi: "Đặt mục tiêu là bước đầu tiên biến điều vô hình thành hữu hình."
\"Setting goals is the first step in tur.zh: “设定目标是将无形变为有形的第一步。”

\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.ar: "ابتسم في المرآة. افعل ذلك كل صباح وستبدأ في رؤية فرق كبير في حياتك."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.de: "Lächle in den Spiegel. Tu das jeden Morgen, und du wirst einen großen Unterschied in deinem Leben bemerken."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.en: "Smile in the mirror. Do that every morning and you'll start to see a big difference in your life."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.es: "Sonríe frente al espejo. Hazlo cada mañana y empezarás a ver una gran diferencia en tu vida."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.fr: "Souris dans le miroir. Fais-le chaque matin et tu verras une grande différence dans ta vie."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.hi: "आईने में मुस्कुराइए। हर सुबह ऐसा कीजिए और आप अपनी ज़िंदगी में बड़ा बदलाव देखने लगेंगे।"
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.id: "Tersenyumlah di depan cermin. Lakukan itu setiap pagi, dan kau akan mulai melihat perubahan besar dalam hidupmu."
