\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.it: "Sorridi allo specchio. Fallo ogni mattina e comincerai a vedere una grande differenza nella tua vita."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.ja: 「鏡に向かって笑ってみよう。毎朝それを続ければ、人生が大きく変わり始める。」
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.ko: "거울을 보며 웃으세요. 매일 아침 그렇게 하면 삶이 크게 달라지는 것을 보게 될 것입니다."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.pt: "Sorria no espelho. Faça isso toda manhã e você começará a ver uma grande diferença na sua vida."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.ru: «Улыбайтесь себе в зеркало. Делайте это каждое утро — и вы увидите, как сильно изменится ваша жизнь.»
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.th: "ยิ้มให้กระจก ทำทุกเช้าแล้วคุณจะเริ่มเห็นความเปลี่ยนแปลงครั้งใหญ่ในชีวิต"
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.tr: "Aynada gülümse. Bunu her sabah yap; hayatında büyük bir fark görmeye başlayacaksın."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.vi: "Hãy cười với mình trong gương. Làm vậy mỗi sáng và bạn sẽ thấy đời mình khác đi rất nhiều."
\"Smile in the mirror. Do that every mor.zh: “对着镜子微笑。每天早晨这样做，你就会开始看到生活中的巨大变化。”

\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.ar: "انشر الحب في كل مكان تذهب إليه. لا تدع أحدًا يأتي إليك دون أن يرحل أكثر سعادة."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.de: "Verbreite Liebe, wohin du auch gehst. Lass niemanden zu dir kommen, ohne dass er glücklicher wieder geht."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.en: "Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.es: "Difunde amor a donde vayas. Que nadie llegue a ti sin irse más feliz."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.fr: "Répands l'amour partout où tu vas. Que personne ne vienne à toi sans repartir plus heureux."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.hi: "जहाँ भी जाएँ, प्रेम बाँटें। आपके पास आया कोई भी इंसान पहले से ज़्यादा खुश होकर ही लौटे।"
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.id: "Sebarkan cinta ke mana pun kau pergi. Jangan biarkan siapa pun datang kepadamu tanpa pergi dengan lebih bahagia."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.it: "Diffondi amore dovunque tu vada. Che nessuno venga a te senza andarsene più felice."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.ja: 「行く先どこにでも愛を広めよう。あなたのもとを訪れた人が、来た時より幸せにならずに帰ることのないように。」
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.ko: "가는 곳마다 사랑을 전하라. 당신을 찾아온 사람이 더 행복해지지 않고 떠나는 일이 없게 하라."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.pt: "Espalhe amor por onde você for. Que ninguém chegue até você sem sair mais feliz."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.ru: «Несите любовь всюду, куда идёте. Пусть никто не уйдёт от вас, не став счастливее.»
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.th: "หยิบยื่นความรักไปทุกที่ที่คุณไป อย่าให้ใครจากคุณไปโดยไม่มีความสุขมากขึ้น"
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.tr: "Gittiğin her yere sevgi saç. Sana gelen hiç kimse daha mutlu olmadan ayrılmasın."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.vi: "Hãy gieo yêu thương ở mọi nơi bạn đến. Đừng để ai rời khỏi bạn mà không vui hơn."
\"Spread love everywhere you go. Let no.zh: “无论你走到哪里，都要传播爱。让任何来找你的人，离开时都比来时更快乐。”

\"Start where you are. Use what you have.ar: "ابدأ من حيث أنت. استخدم ما لديك. افعل ما تستطيع."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.de: "Fang dort an, wo du bist. Nutze, was du hast. Tu, was du kannst."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.en: "Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.es: "Empieza donde estás. Usa lo que tienes. Haz lo que puedas."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.fr: "Commence là où tu es. Utilise ce que tu as. Fais ce que tu peux."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.hi: "जहाँ हैं वहीं से शुरू करें। जो है उसका इस्तेमाल करें। जो कर सकते हैं वह करें।"
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.id: "Mulailah dari tempatmu berada. Gunakan apa yang kau punya. Lakukan apa yang kau bisa."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.it: "Comincia da dove sei. Usa quello che hai. Fai quello che puoi."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.ja: 「今いる場所から始めよう。持っているものを使おう。できることをしよう。」
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.ko: "지금 있는 곳에서 시작하라. 가진 것을 사용하라. 할 수 있는 것을 하라."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.pt: "Comece de onde você está. Use o que você tem. Faça o que você pode."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.ru: «Начни там, где ты есть. Используй то, что имеешь. Делай то, что можешь.»
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.th: "เริ่มจากจุดที่คุณอยู่ ใช้สิ่งที่คุณมี ทำสิ่งที่คุณทำได้"
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.tr: "Bulunduğun yerden başla. Elindekini kullan. Yapabileceğini yap."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.vi: "Hãy bắt đầu từ nơi bạn đang đứng. Dùng những gì bạn có. Làm những gì bạn có thể."
\"Start where you are. Use what you have.zh: “从你现在的位置开始。利用你所拥有的。尽你所能。”

\"The best and most beautiful things in.ar: "أفضل وأجمل ما في العالم لا يُرى ولا يُلمس — بل يُشعر به بالقلب."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.de: "Die besten und schönsten Dinge auf der Welt kann man nicht sehen und nicht berühren - man muss sie mit dem Herzen fühlen."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.en: "The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.es: "Las cosas mejores y más bellas del mundo no se pueden ver ni tocar: se deben sentir con el corazón."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.fr: "Les choses les meilleures et les plus belles du monde ne peuvent être vues ni même touchées - elles doivent être ressenties avec le cœur."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.hi: "दुनिया की सबसे अच्छी और सबसे सुंदर चीज़ें न देखी जा सकती हैं और न छुई जा सकती हैं — उन्हें दिल से महसूस करना पड़ता है।"
\"The best and most beautiful things in.id: "Hal terbaik dan terindah di dunia tak bisa dilihat atau bahkan disentuh - semuanya harus dirasakan dengan hati."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.it: "Le cose migliori e più belle del mondo non si possono vedere né toccare: si devono sentire col cuore."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.ja: 「世界で最も素晴らしく美しいものは、見ることも触れることもできない。心で感じるしかないのだ。」
\"The best and most beautiful things in.ko: "세상에서 가장 좋고 아름다운 것은 보이지도, 만져지지도 않는다. 그것은 마음으로 느껴야 한다."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.pt: "As melhores e mais belas coisas do mundo não podem ser vistas nem tocadas - precisam ser sentidas com o coração."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.ru: «Самое лучшее и самое прекрасное в мире нельзя увидеть или потрогать — это можно почувствовать только сердцем.»
\"The best and most beautiful things in.th: "สิ่งที่ดีที่สุดและงดงามที่สุดในโลกนี้มองไม่เห็นและสัมผัสไม่ได้ - ต้องรู้สึกด้วยหัวใจ"
\"The best and most beautiful things in.tr: "Dünyadaki en iyi ve en güzel şeyler görülemez, hatta dokunulamaz - onlar kalple duyulmalıdır."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.vi: "Những điều tốt đẹp nhất trên thế gian không thể thấy hay chạm tới - phải cảm nhận bằng trái tim."
\"The best and most beautiful things in.zh: “世界上最美好、最美丽的事物是看不见或摸不着的，必须用心去感受。”

\"The meaning of things lies not in the.ar: "معنى الأشياء لا يكمن في الأشياء نفسها، بل في موقفنا منها."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.de: "Der Sinn der Dinge liegt nicht in den Dingen selbst, sondern in unserer Haltung ihnen gegenüber."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.en: "The meaning of things lies not in the things themselves, but in our attitude towards them."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.es: "El significado de las cosas no está en las cosas mismas, sino en nuestra actitud hacia ellas."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.fr: "Le sens des choses ne réside pas dans les choses elles-mêmes, mais dans notre attitude à leur égard."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.hi: "चीज़ों का अर्थ उन चीज़ों में नहीं, बल्कि उनके प्रति हमारे नज़रिए में होता है।"
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.id: "Makna segala sesuatu tidak terletak pada benda itu sendiri, melainkan pada sikap kita terhadapnya."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.it: "Il significato delle cose non sta nelle cose stesse, ma nel nostro atteggiamento verso di esse."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.ja: 「物事の意味は、物事そのものではなく、それに対する私たちの態度にある。」
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.ko: "사물의 의미는 사물 자체에 있지 않고, 그것을 향한 우리의 태도에 있다."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.pt: "O significado das coisas não está nas coisas em si, mas na nossa atitude em relação a elas."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.ru: «Смысл вещей не в самих вещах, а в нашем отношении к ним.»
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.th: "ความหมายของสิ่งต่าง ๆ ไม่ได้อยู่ที่ตัวมันเอง แต่อยู่ที่ทัศนคติของเราต่อมัน"
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.tr: "Şeylerin anlamı kendilerinde değil, onlara karşı tutumumuzda yatar."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.vi: "Ý nghĩa của sự vật không nằm ở bản thân chúng, mà ở thái độ của ta với chúng."
\"The meaning of things lies not in the.zh: “事物的意义不在于事物本身，而在于我们对待它们的态度。”

\"The most important thing is to try and.ar: "الأهم من كل شيء أن تحاول إلهام الناس ليكونوا عظماء في أي شيء يريدون فعله."
\"The most important thing is to try and.de: "Das Wichtigste ist, Menschen zu inspirieren, damit sie in allem, was sie tun wollen, großartig sein können."
\"The most important thing is to try and.en: "The most important thing is to try and inspire people so that they can be great in whatever they want to do."
\"The most important thing is to try and.es: "Lo más importante es tratar de inspirar a las personas para que puedan ser grandes en lo que quieran hacer."
\"The most important thing is to try and.fr: "L'essentiel est d'essayer d'inspirer les gens, pour qu'ils puissent être grands dans tout ce qu'ils entreprennent."
\"The most important thing is to try and.hi: "सबसे ज़रूरी है लोगों को प्रेरित करने की कोशिश करना, ताकि वे जो भी करना चाहें उसमें महान बन सकें।"
\"The most important thing is to try and.id: "Yang terpenting adalah berusaha menginspirasi orang lain agar mereka bisa hebat dalam apa pun yang ingin mereka lakukan."
\"The most important thing is to try and.it: "La cosa più importante è provare a ispirare le persone, perché possano essere grandi in qualunque cosa vogliano fare."
\"The most important thing is to try and.ja: 「最も大切なのは、人を励まし、その人がやりたいことで偉大になれるようにすることだ。」
\"The most important thing is to try and.ko: "가장 중요한 것은 사람들이 무엇을 하든 위대해질 수 있도록 영감을 주려 애쓰는 것이다."
\"The most important thing is to try and.pt: "O mais importante é tentar inspirar as pessoas para que elas possam ser grandes em tudo o que quiserem fazer."
\"The most important thing is to try and.ru: «Самое важное — вдохновлять людей, чтобы они стали великими в том, чем хотят заниматься.»
\"The most important thing is to try and.th: "สิ่งสำคัญที่สุดคือการพยายามจุดไฟให้ผู้คน เพื่อให้พวกเขายิ่งใหญ่ในสิ่งที่อยากทำ"
\"The most important thing is to try and.tr: "En önemli şey, insanlara ilham vermeye çalışmaktır; böylece ne yapmak isterlerse onda büyük olabilirler."
\"The most important thing is to try and.vi: "Điều quan trọng nhất là truyền cảm hứng cho mọi người, để họ có thể xuất sắc trong bất cứ điều họ muốn làm."
\"The most important thing is to try and.zh: “最重要的是尽力激励人们，使他们能够在自己想做的事情上取得成功。”

\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.ar: "أكثر ما يمنح الحياة معنى هو أن تكون قادرًا على منح جزء كبير من نفسك للآخرين."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.de: "Das Erfüllendste im Leben ist, einen großen Teil von sich selbst an andere weitergeben zu können."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.en: "The most satisfying thing in life is to have been able to give a large part of one's self to others."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.es: "Lo más satisfactorio de la vida es haber podido dar a los demás una gran parte de uno mismo."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.fr: "Ce qu'il y a de plus satisfaisant dans la vie, c'est d'avoir pu donner une grande part de soi-même aux autres."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.hi: "ज़िंदगी में सबसे संतोष देने वाली बात यह है कि आप खुद का एक बड़ा हिस्सा दूसरों को दे सकें।"
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.id: "Hal paling memuaskan dalam hidup adalah mampu memberikan sebagian besar diri kita kepada orang lain."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.it: "La cosa più appagante della vita è aver potuto donare agli altri gran parte di sé stessi."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.ja: 「人生で最も満ち足りることは、自分自身の大きな部分を他者に与えられたということだ。」
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.ko: "인생에서 가장 만족스러운 일은 자기 자신의 많은 부분을 다른 이에게 내줄 수 있었다는 것이다."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.pt: "A coisa mais gratificante da vida é ter conseguido dar grande parte de si mesmo aos outros."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.ru: «Самое большое удовлетворение в жизни — суметь отдать большую часть себя другим.»
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.th: "สิ่งที่ทำให้ชีวิตอิ่มเอมที่สุด คือการได้มอบส่วนใหญ่ของตัวเราเองให้แก่ผู้อื่น"
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.tr: "Hayatta en doyurucu şey, insanın kendisinin büyük bir bölümünü başkalarına verebilmiş olmasıdır."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.vi: "Điều thỏa nguyện nhất trong đời là đã có thể trao phần lớn con người mình cho người khác."
\"The most satisfying thing in life is t.zh: “人生最令人满足的事，就是能够将自己的很大一部分奉献给他人。”

\"The only person you should try to be b.ar: "الشخص الوحيد الذي عليك أن تحاول التفوق عليه هو أنت في الأمس."
\"The only person you should try to be b.de: "Der Einzige, den du übertreffen solltest, ist der Mensch, der du gestern warst."
\"The only person you should try to be b.en: "The only person you should try to be better than, is the person you were yesterday."
\"The only person you should try to be b.es: "La única persona a la que deberías intentar superar es la persona que fuiste ayer."
\"The only person you should try to be b.fr: "La seule personne que tu devrais chercher à surpasser, c'est celle que tu étais hier."
\"The only person you should try to be b.hi: "आपको जिस एक इंसान से बेहतर बनने की कोशिश करनी चाहिए, वह है कल का आप।"
\"The only person you should try to be b.id: "Satu-satunya orang yang perlu kau lampaui adalah dirimu sendiri yang kemarin."
\"The only person you should try to be b.it: "L'unica persona che dovresti cercare di superare è la persona che eri ieri."
\"The only person you should try to be b.ja: 「超えようとすべき相手は、昨日の自分だけだ。」
\"The only person you should try to be b.ko: "당신이 넘어서려 애써야 할 유일한 사람은 어제의 당신이다."
\"The only person you should try to be b.pt: "A única pessoa que você deve tentar superar é a pessoa que você era ontem."
\"The only person you should try to be b.ru: «Единственный, кого стоит превзойти, — это ты сам вчерашний.»
\"The only person you should try to be b.th: "คนเดียวที่คุณควรพยายามเก่งกว่า คือตัวคุณเมื่อวาน"
\"The only person you should try to be b.tr: "Daha iyi olmaya çalışman gereken tek kişi, dünkü halindir."
\"The only person you should try to be b.vi: "Người duy nhất bạn nên cố vượt qua là chính bạn ngày hôm qua."
\"The only person you should try to be b.zh: “你唯一应该努力超越的人，就是昨天的自己。”

\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.de: "Der Sinn unseres Lebens ist es, glücklich zu sein."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.en: "The purpose of our lives is to be happy."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.es: "El propósito de nuestra vida es ser felices."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.fr: "Le but de nos vies est d'être heureux."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.hi: "हमारे जीवन का उद्देश्य खुश रहना है।"
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.it: "Lo scopo della nostra vita è essere felici."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.ja: 「私たちの人生の目的は、幸せになることだ。」
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.pt: "O propósito das nossas vidas é ser feliz."
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.th: "จุดหมายของชีวิตเราคือการมีความสุข"
\"The purpose of our lives is to be happ.vi: "Mục đích của đời ta là được hạnh phúc."

\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.ar: "سر السعادة الحقيقي يكمن في الاهتمام الصادق بكل تفاصيل الحياة اليومية."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.de: "Das wahre Geheimnis des Glücks liegt darin, an allen Einzelheiten des täglichen Lebens echtes Interesse zu nehmen."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.en: "The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.es: "El verdadero secreto de la felicidad está en interesarse de verdad por todos los detalles de la vida diaria."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.fr: "Le véritable secret du bonheur réside dans un intérêt sincère pour tous les détails de la vie quotidienne."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.hi: "खुशी का असली राज़ रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी की हर छोटी बात में सच्ची दिलचस्पी लेने में है।"
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.id: "Rahasia sejati kebahagiaan terletak pada minat yang tulus terhadap segala detail kehidupan sehari-hari."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.it: "Il vero segreto della felicità sta nel prendere un interesse sincero per tutti i dettagli della vita quotidiana."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.ja: 「幸福の本当の秘訣は、日常のあらゆる細部に心からの関心を寄せることにある。」
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.ko: "행복의 진정한 비밀은 일상의 모든 세부에 진심으로 관심을 갖는 데 있다."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.pt: "O verdadeiro segredo da felicidade está em se interessar de verdade por todos os detalhes da vida cotidiana."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.ru: «Настоящий секрет счастья — в искреннем интересе ко всем мелочам повседневной жизни.»
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.th: "ความลับที่แท้จริงของความสุข คือการสนใจอย่างจริงใจในทุกรายละเอียดของชีวิตประจำวัน"
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.tr: "Mutluluğun gerçek sırrı, günlük yaşamın tüm ayrıntılarına içten bir ilgi göstermekte yatar."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.vi: "Bí mật thật sự của hạnh phúc nằm ở sự quan tâm chân thành đến mọi chi tiết của đời sống thường ngày."
\"The true secret of happiness lies in t.zh: “幸福的真正秘诀在于对日常生活的所有细节产生真正的兴趣。”

\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.ar: "ثلاثة أشياء لا يمكن إخفاؤها طويلًا: الشمس والقمر والحقيقة."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.de: "Drei Dinge lassen sich nicht lange verbergen: die Sonne, der Mond und die Wahrheit."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.en: "Three things cannot be long hidden: the sun, the moon, and the truth."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.es: "Tres cosas no pueden ocultarse por mucho tiempo: el sol, la luna y la verdad."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.fr: "Trois choses ne peuvent rester longtemps cachées : le soleil, la lune et la vérité."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.hi: "तीन चीज़ें ज़्यादा देर छिपी नहीं रह सकतीं: सूरज, चाँद और सच।"
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.id: "Tiga hal tak bisa lama disembunyikan: matahari, bulan, dan kebenaran."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.it: "Tre cose non possono restare nascoste a lungo: il sole, la luna e la verità."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.ja: 「長く隠しておけないものが三つある。太陽、月、そして真実だ。」
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.ko: "세 가지는 오래 숨길 수 없다. 해, 달, 그리고 진실이다."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.pt: "Três coisas não podem ficar escondidas por muito tempo: o sol, a lua e a verdade."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.ru: «Три вещи нельзя скрывать долго: солнце, луну и правду.»
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.th: "สามสิ่งที่ซ่อนไว้ได้ไม่นาน คือดวงอาทิตย์ ดวงจันทร์ และความจริง"
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.tr: "Üç şey uzun süre gizli kalmaz: güneş, ay ve gerçek."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.vi: "Ba điều không thể che giấu lâu: mặt trời, mặt trăng và sự thật."
\"Three things cannot be long hidden: th.zh: “有三件事物无法长久隐藏：太阳，月亮和真相。”

\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.ar: "أن تتحسن يعني أن تتغير؛ وأن تكون كاملًا يعني أن تتغير كثيرًا."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.de: "Sich verbessern heißt sich verändern; perfekt sein heißt sich oft verändern."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.en: "To improve is to change; to be perfect is to change often."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.es: "Mejorar es cambiar; ser perfecto es cambiar a menudo."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.fr: "S'améliorer, c'est changer ; être parfait, c'est changer souvent."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.hi: "सुधरना यानी बदलना; पूर्ण होना यानी बार-बार बदलना।"
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.id: "Menjadi lebih baik berarti berubah; menjadi sempurna berarti sering berubah."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.it: "Migliorare è cambiare; essere perfetti è cambiare spesso."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.ja: 「向上とは変わること。完璧とは何度も変わることだ。」
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.ko: "발전하는 것은 변하는 것이고, 완벽해지는 것은 자주 변하는 것이다."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.pt: "Melhorar é mudar; ser perfeito é mudar sempre."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.ru: «Совершенствоваться — значит меняться; быть совершенным — значит меняться часто.»
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.th: "การพัฒนาคือการเปลี่ยนแปลง ความสมบูรณ์แบบคือการเปลี่ยนแปลงบ่อย ๆ"
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.tr: "Gelişmek değişmektir; mükemmel olmak sık sık değişmektir."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.vi: "Tiến bộ là thay đổi; hoàn hảo là thay đổi thường xuyên."
\"To improve is to change; to be perfect.zh: “要改进就必须改变；要完美就必须经常改变。”

\"We do not remember days, we remember m.ar: "نحن لا نتذكر الأيام، بل نتذكر اللحظات."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.de: "Wir erinnern uns nicht an Tage, wir erinnern uns an Momente."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.en: "We do not remember days, we remember moments."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.es: "No recordamos los días, recordamos los momentos."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.fr: "Nous ne nous souvenons pas des jours, nous nous souvenons des instants."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.hi: "हमें दिन याद नहीं रहते, हमें पल याद रहते हैं।"
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.id: "Kita tidak mengingat hari-hari, kita mengingat momen."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.it: "Non ricordiamo i giorni, ricordiamo i momenti."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.ja: 「私たちが覚えているのは日々ではなく、瞬間だ。」
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.ko: "우리는 날들을 기억하지 않는다. 우리는 순간들을 기억한다."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.pt: "Não nos lembramos de dias, lembramos de momentos."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.ru: «Мы помним не дни, мы помним мгновения.»
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.th: "เราไม่ได้จำวันคืน เราจำช่วงเวลา"
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.vi: "Chúng ta không nhớ những ngày, chúng ta nhớ những khoảnh khắc."
\"We do not remember days, we remember m.zh: “我们记住的不是日子，而是瞬间。”

\"We make a living by what we get, but w.ar: "نكسب عيشنا بما نأخذ، لكننا نصنع حياتنا بما نعطي."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.de: "Wir verdienen unseren Lebensunterhalt mit dem, was wir bekommen, aber wir gestalten unser Leben mit dem, was wir geben."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.en: "We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.es: "Nos ganamos la vida con lo que recibimos, pero construimos una vida con lo que damos."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.fr: "Nous gagnons notre vie avec ce que nous recevons, mais nous bâtissons notre vie avec ce que nous donnons."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.hi: "जो हम पाते हैं उससे हम रोज़ी कमाते हैं, पर जो हम देते हैं उससे हम ज़िंदगी बनाते हैं।"
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.id: "Kita mencari penghidupan dari apa yang kita dapat, tapi kita membangun kehidupan dari apa yang kita beri."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.it: "Ci guadagniamo da vivere con quello che riceviamo, ma costruiamo una vita con quello che diamo."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.ja: 「私たちは得るものによって生計を立て、与えるものによって人生を築く。」
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.ko: "우리는 얻는 것으로 생계를 유지하지만, 주는 것으로 삶을 만든다."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.pt: "Ganhamos a vida com o que recebemos, mas construímos a vida com o que damos."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.ru: «Мы зарабатываем на жизнь тем, что получаем, а саму жизнь создаём тем, что отдаём.»
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.th: "เราหาเลี้ยงชีพจากสิ่งที่เราได้รับ แต่เราสร้างชีวิตจากสิ่งที่เราให้"
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.tr: "Aldıklarımızla geçimimizi sağlarız, verdiklerimizle bir hayat kurarız."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.vi: "Ta mưu sinh bằng những gì ta nhận, nhưng ta tạo nên cuộc đời bằng những gì ta cho."
\"We make a living by what we get, but w.zh: “我们靠所得来谋生，但我们靠付出而生活。”

\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.ar: "نبتلع بشراهة أي كذبة تُطرينا، لكننا نرتشف قليلًا قليلًا حقيقةً نجدها مُرّة."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.de: "Jede Lüge, die uns schmeichelt, schlucken wir begierig, aber an einer Wahrheit, die uns bitter erscheint, nippen wir nur Schluck für Schluck."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.en: "We swallow greedily any lie that flatters us, but we sip only little by little at a truth we find bitter."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.es: "Nos tragamos con avidez cualquier mentira que nos halaga, pero bebemos solo a sorbos una verdad que nos resulta amarga."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.fr: "Nous avalons goulûment tout mensonge qui nous flatte, mais nous ne buvons qu'à petites gorgées une vérité qui nous est amère."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.hi: "जो झूठ हमारी चापलूसी करता है उसे हम लालच से निगल जाते हैं, पर जो सच कड़वा लगता है उसे हम घूँट-घूँट पीते हैं।"
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.id: "Kita menelan dengan rakus setiap kebohongan yang menyanjung kita, tapi kita hanya menyesap sedikit demi sedikit kebenaran yang terasa pahit."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.it: "Inghiottiamo con avidità qualsiasi bugia che ci lusinga, ma sorseggiamo solo a poco a poco una verità che troviamo amara."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.ja: 「私たちはお世辞の嘘なら貪るように飲み込むが、苦いと感じる真実は少しずつしか口にしない。」
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.ko: "우리는 우리를 치켜세우는 거짓말은 탐욕스럽게 삼키지만, 쓰다고 느끼는 진실은 조금씩만 마신다."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.pt: "Engolimos com voracidade qualquer mentira que nos lisonjeia, mas bebemos só aos pouquinhos uma verdade que nos parece amarga."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.ru: «Любую лестную ложь мы жадно проглатываем, а горькую правду отпиваем лишь понемногу.»
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.th: "เรากลืนคำโกหกที่ประจบเราอย่างตะกละตะกลาม แต่จิบความจริงที่ขมขื่นเพียงทีละน้อย"
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.tr: "Bizi pohpohlayan her yalanı hevesle yutarız, ama acı bulduğumuz bir gerçeği yalnızca yavaş yavaş yudumlarız."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.vi: "Ta ngấu nghiến mọi lời dối ngọt ngào, nhưng chỉ nhấm nháp từng chút sự thật mà ta thấy đắng."
\"We swallow greedily any lie that flatt.zh: “我们贪婪地吞下任何奉承我们的谎言，但我们却只能一点一点地品尝我们认为痛苦的真相。”

\"What you do today can improve all your.ar: "ما تفعله اليوم يمكن أن يحسّن كل أيام غدك."
\"What you do today can improve all your.de: "Was du heute tust, kann all deine Morgen besser machen."
\"What you do today can improve all your.en: "What you do today can improve all your tomorrows."
\"What you do today can improve all your.es: "Lo que haces hoy puede mejorar todos tus mañanas."
\"What you do today can improve all your.fr: "Ce que tu fais aujourd'hui peut améliorer tous tes lendemains."
\"What you do today can improve all your.hi: "आज आप जो करते हैं, वह आपके सारे कल सुधार सकता है।"
\"What you do today can improve all your.id: "Apa yang kau lakukan hari ini bisa memperbaiki seluruh hari esokmu."
\"What you do today can improve all your.it: "Quello che fai oggi può migliorare tutti i tuoi domani."
\"What you do today can improve all your.ja: 「今日の行いは、これから来るすべての明日をより良くできる。」
\"What you do today can improve all your.ko: "오늘 하는 일이 당신의 모든 내일을 더 좋게 만들 수 있다."
\"What you do today can improve all your.pt: "O que você faz hoje pode melhorar todos os seus amanhãs."
\"What you do today can improve all your.ru: «То, что ты делаешь сегодня, может улучшить все твои завтра.»
\"What you do today can improve all your.th: "สิ่งที่คุณทำวันนี้ทำให้ทุกวันพรุ่งนี้ของคุณดีขึ้นได้"
\"What you do today can improve all your.vi: "Điều bạn làm hôm nay có thể cải thiện mọi ngày mai của bạn."
\"What you do today can improve all your.zh: “您今天所做的一切可以改善您的所有明天。”

\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.ar: "أيًّا كان ما تمنحني إياه الحياة، سأتقبله وأكون ممتنًا له أيضًا."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.de: "Was das Leben mir auch entgegenwirft: Ich nehme es an und bin dankbar dafür."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.en: "Whatever life throws at me I'll take it and be grateful for it as well."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.es: "Sea lo que sea que la vida me dé, lo aceptaré y además lo agradeceré."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.fr: "Quoi que la vie m'envoie, je l'accepterai et j'en serai même reconnaissant."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.hi: "ज़िंदगी मेरे सामने जो भी रखे, मैं उसे स्वीकार करूँगा और उसके लिए आभारी भी रहूँगा।"
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.id: "Apa pun yang hidup berikan kepadaku, akan kuterima dan kusyukuri."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.it: "Qualunque cosa la vita mi riservi, la accoglierò e ne sarò anche grato."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.ja: 「人生が何を投げかけてきても、私はそれを受け取り、感謝もする。」
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.ko: "삶이 무엇을 던져주든 나는 그것을 받아들이고 감사하겠다."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.pt: "O que a vida me trouxer, eu aceito e agradeço por isso também."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.ru: «Что бы ни подбросила мне жизнь, я приму это — и ещё буду благодарен.»
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.th: "ไม่ว่าชีวิตจะหยิบยื่นอะไรมาให้ ฉันจะรับไว้และรู้สึกขอบคุณมันด้วย"
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.tr: "Hayat karşıma ne çıkarırsa kabul ederim, üstelik bunun için minnettar olurum."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.vi: "Dù cuộc sống mang đến điều gì, tôi đều nhận lấy và biết ơn vì điều đó."
\"Whatever life throws at me I'll take i.zh: “无论生活给我带来什么，我都会接受并且心存感激。”

\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.ar: "عندما تكون متحمسًا لما تفعله، تشعر بهذه الطاقة الإيجابية. الأمر بسيط جدًا."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.de: "Wenn du begeistert von dem bist, was du tust, spürst du diese positive Energie. Es ist ganz einfach."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.en: "When you are enthusiastic about what you do, you feel this positive energy. It's very simple."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.es: "Cuando te entusiasma lo que haces, sientes esa energía positiva. Es muy simple."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.fr: "Quand tu es enthousiaste dans ce que tu fais, tu ressens cette énergie positive. C'est très simple."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.hi: "जब आप अपने काम के लिए जुनून रखते हैं, तो आप यह सकारात्मक ऊर्जा महसूस करते हैं। बात बहुत सीधी है।"
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.id: "Saat kau antusias dengan apa yang kau lakukan, kau merasakan energi positif itu. Sesederhana itu."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.it: "Quando sei entusiasta di quello che fai, senti questa energia positiva. È molto semplice."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.ja: 「自分のすることに情熱を持てば、この前向きなエネルギーを感じられる。とても単純なことだ。」
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.ko: "자신이 하는 일에 열정을 느끼면 이 긍정적인 에너지가 느껴진다. 아주 단순한 일이다."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.pt: "Quando você tem entusiasmo pelo que faz, você sente essa energia positiva. É muito simples."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.ru: «Когда ты увлечён тем, что делаешь, ты чувствуешь эту позитивную энергию. Всё очень просто.»
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.th: "เวลาคุณกระตือรือร้นกับสิ่งที่ทำ คุณจะรู้สึกถึงพลังบวกนี้ มันง่ายมากเลย"
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.tr: "Yaptığın şey için heyecan duyduğunda bu pozitif enerjiyi hissedersin. Çok basit."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.vi: "Khi bạn say mê điều mình làm, bạn cảm nhận được nguồn năng lượng tích cực ấy. Rất đơn giản."
\"When you are enthusiastic about what y.zh: “当你对自己所做的事情充满热情时，你就会感受到这种积极的能量。这很简单。”

\"Whether you think you can or you think.ar: "سواء ظننت أنك قادر أو ظننت أنك غير قادر، فأنت محق!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.de: "Ob du glaubst, du kannst es, oder du glaubst, du kannst es nicht - du hast recht!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.en: "Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.es: "Tanto si crees que puedes como si crees que no puedes, ¡tienes razón!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.fr: "Que tu penses pouvoir ou ne pas pouvoir, tu as raison !"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.hi: "आप सोचते हैं कि आप कर सकते हैं या नहीं कर सकते — दोनों हाल में आप सही हैं!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.id: "Entah kau pikir kau bisa atau kau pikir kau tak bisa, kau benar!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.it: "Che tu pensi di potercela fare o di non potercela fare, hai ragione!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.ja: 「できると思うか、できないと思うか。どちらにしてもあなたの思う通りになる！」
\"Whether you think you can or you think.ko: "할 수 있다고 생각하든 할 수 없다고 생각하든, 당신 생각이 맞다!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.pt: "Se você acha que consegue ou acha que não consegue, você está certo!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.ru: «Думаете, что можете, или думаете, что не можете, — вы правы в любом случае!»
\"Whether you think you can or you think.th: "ไม่ว่าคุณคิดว่าทำได้หรือคิดว่าทำไม่ได้ คุณก็คิดถูกทั้งนั้น!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.tr: "Yapabileceğini de düşünsen, yapamayacağını da düşünsen haklısın!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.vi: "Dù bạn nghĩ mình làm được hay không làm được, bạn đều đúng!"
\"Whether you think you can or you think.zh: “无论你认为自己能行还是不能行，你都是对的！”

\"With the new day comes new strength an.ar: "مع اليوم الجديد تأتي قوة جديدة وأفكار جديدة."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.de: "Mit dem neuen Tag kommen neue Kraft und neue Gedanken."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.en: "With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.es: "Con el nuevo día llegan nuevas fuerzas y nuevos pensamientos."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.fr: "Avec le jour nouveau viennent des forces nouvelles et des pensées nouvelles."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.hi: "नया दिन नई ताक़त और नए विचार लेकर आता है।"
\"With the new day comes new strength an.id: "Bersama hari yang baru datang kekuatan baru dan pikiran baru."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.it: "Con il nuovo giorno arrivano nuove forze e nuovi pensieri."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.ja: 「新しい一日は、新しい力と新しい考えを連れてくる。」
\"With the new day comes new strength an.ko: "새로운 하루와 함께 새로운 힘과 새로운 생각이 온다."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.pt: "Com o novo dia vêm novas forças e novos pensamentos."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.ru: «Новый день приносит новые силы и новые мысли.»
\"With the new day comes new strength an.th: "วันใหม่มาพร้อมกับพลังใหม่และความคิดใหม่"
\"With the new day comes new strength an.tr: "Yeni günle birlikte yeni güç ve yeni düşünceler gelir."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.vi: "Ngày mới đến cùng sức mạnh mới và ý nghĩ mới."
\"With the new day comes new strength an.zh: “新的一天带来新的力量和新的想法。”

\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.ar: "الأمس تاريخ، والغد لغز، واليوم هدية؛ ولهذا نسميه الحاضر."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.de: "Gestern ist Geschichte. Morgen ist ein Geheimnis. Heute ist ein Geschenk; darum nennen wir es die Gegenwart."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.en: "Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a mystery. Today is a gift; that's why we call it The Present."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.es: "Ayer es historia. Mañana es un misterio. Hoy es un regalo: por eso lo llamamos el Presente."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.fr: "Hier est de l'histoire. Demain est un mystère. Aujourd'hui est un cadeau ; c'est pourquoi on l'appelle le Présent."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.hi: "बीता कल इतिहास है। आने वाला कल रहस्य है। आज एक तोहफ़ा है; इसीलिए हम इसे वर्तमान कहते हैं।"
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.id: "Kemarin adalah sejarah. Besok adalah misteri. Hari ini adalah hadiah; itulah sebabnya kita menyebutnya masa kini."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.it: "Ieri è storia. Domani è un mistero. Oggi è un dono: ecco perché lo chiamiamo Presente."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.ja: 「昨日は歴史、明日は謎、今日は贈り物。だから今日を『プレゼント』と呼ぶのだ。」
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.ko: "어제는 역사, 내일은 미스터리, 오늘은 선물이다. 그래서 우리는 오늘을 '현재'라고 부른다."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.pt: "Ontem é história. Amanhã é um mistério. Hoje é um presente; é por isso que o chamamos de Presente."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.ru: «Вчера — это история. Завтра — тайна. Сегодня — подарок, потому мы и называем его настоящим.»
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.th: "เมื่อวานคือประวัติศาสตร์ พรุ่งนี้คือปริศนา วันนี้คือของขวัญ เพราะอย่างนั้นเราจึงเรียกมันว่าปัจจุบัน"
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.tr: "Dün tarihtir. Yarın bir gizemdir. Bugün bir armağandır; bu yüzden ona 'şimdiki an' deriz."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.vi: "Hôm qua là lịch sử. Ngày mai là điều bí ẩn. Hôm nay là món quà; vì thế ta gọi nó là hiện tại."
\"Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a my.zh: “昨天是历史，明天是未知，今天是礼物，这就是我们为什么称它为现在。”

\"You must be the change you wish to see.ar: "كن أنت التغيير الذي تريد أن تراه في العالم."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.de: "Sei du selbst die Veränderung, die du in der Welt sehen willst."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.en: "You must be the change you wish to see in the world."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.es: "Sé tú el cambio que quieres ver en el mundo."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.fr: "Sois le changement que tu veux voir dans le monde."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.hi: "दुनिया में जो बदलाव देखना चाहते हैं, वह बदलाव आपको खुद बनना होगा।"
\"You must be the change you wish to see.id: "Jadilah perubahan yang ingin kau lihat di dunia."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.it: "Sii tu il cambiamento che vuoi vedere nel mondo."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.ja: 「世界に望む変化に、あなた自身がなりなさい。」
\"You must be the change you wish to see.ko: "당신이 세상에서 보고 싶은 변화, 그것이 바로 당신이어야 한다."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.pt: "Seja você a mudança que deseja ver no mundo."
\"You must be the change you wish to see.ru: «Стань тем изменением, которое хочешь увидеть в мире.»

\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.ar: "موقفك، لا موهبتك، هو ما يحدد مكانتك."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.de: "Deine Einstellung, nicht deine Begabung, bestimmt, wie hoch du kommst."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.en: "Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.es: "Tu actitud, no tu aptitud, determinará tu altitud."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.fr: "C'est ton attitude, et non ton aptitude, qui déterminera ton altitude."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.hi: "आपकी ऊँचाई आपकी योग्यता से नहीं, आपके नज़रिए से तय होगी।"
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.id: "Sikapmu, bukan bakatmu, yang menentukan seberapa tinggi kau melangkah."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.it: "Il tuo atteggiamento, non la tua attitudine, determinerà la tua altitudine."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.ja: 「あなたの高さを決めるのは、才能ではなく態度だ。」
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.ko: "당신의 높이를 결정하는 것은 당신의 재능이 아니라 당신의 태도다."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.pt: "Sua atitude, e não sua aptidão, vai determinar sua altitude."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.ru: «Твою высоту определяет не одарённость, а настрой.»
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.th: "ทัศนคติของคุณ ไม่ใช่ความสามารถ ที่จะกำหนดว่าคุณจะไปได้สูงแค่ไหน"
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.tr: "Yeteneğin değil, tutumun ne kadar yükseleceğini belirler."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.vi: "Thái độ, chứ không phải năng khiếu, sẽ quyết định độ cao bạn đạt tới."
\"Your attitude, not your aptitude, will.zh: “你的态度，而非天资，决定了你的高度。”

\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.ar: "وقتك محدود، فلا تضيّعه في عيش حياة شخص آخر."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.de: "Deine Zeit ist begrenzt, also verschwende sie nicht damit, das Leben eines anderen zu leben."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.en: "Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.es: "Tu tiempo es limitado, así que no lo desperdicies viviendo la vida de otra persona."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.fr: "Ton temps est limité, ne le gaspille pas à vivre la vie de quelqu'un d'autre."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.hi: "आपका समय सीमित है, इसलिए इसे किसी और की ज़िंदगी जीने में बर्बाद न करें।"
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.id: "Waktumu terbatas, jadi jangan sia-siakan untuk menjalani hidup orang lain."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.it: "Il vostro tempo è limitato, perciò non sprecatelo vivendo la vita di qualcun altro."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.ja: 「あなたの時間は限られている。だから他人の人生を生きて無駄にしてはいけない。」
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.ko: "당신의 시간은 한정되어 있다. 그러니 남의 삶을 사느라 시간을 낭비하지 마라."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.pt: "Seu tempo é limitado, então não o desperdice vivendo a vida de outra pessoa."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.ru: «Ваше время ограничено, не тратьте его на то, чтобы жить чужой жизнью.»
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.th: "เวลาของคุณมีจำกัด อย่าเสียมันไปกับการใช้ชีวิตของคนอื่น"
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.tr: "Zamanın sınırlı, bu yüzden onu başkasının hayatını yaşayarak harcama."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.vi: "Thời gian của bạn có hạn, đừng phí nó để sống cuộc đời của người khác."
\"Your time is limited, so don't waste i.zh: “你时间有限，所以不要浪费时间过别人的生活。”

These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.ar: هذه اشتراكات ذات تجديد تلقائي. سيتم خصم المبلغ من حساب Google Play الخاص بك بعد تأكيد الشراء. سيتم تجديد اشتراكك تلقائيًا ما لم يتم إيقاف التجديد التلقائي قبل 24 ساعة على الأقل من نهاية دورة الفوترة الحالية. تتم معالجة رسوم التجديد خلال مدة تصل إلى 24 ساعة قبل انتهاء فترتك النشطة. يمكنك إدارة اشتراكك أو إلغاؤه في أي وقت من صفحة الاشتراكات في إعدادات حسابك بمتجر Google Play. في حال الإلغاء، تحتفظ بحق الوصول الكامل إلى جميع مزايا الاشتراك حتى نهاية دورة الفوترة الحالية. لا يتم رد أي مبالغ جزئية عن فترة الفوترة الجارية، وذلك وفقًا لسياسة رد الأموال الرسمية في Google Play. لا يصبح الإلغاء ساريًا إلا بعد انتهاء فترة اشتراكك الحالية.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.de: Dies sind automatisch verlängerbare Abonnements. Die Zahlung wird nach Bestätigung des Kaufs über dein Google-Play-Konto abgebucht. Dein Abonnement verlängert sich automatisch, sofern die automatische Verlängerung nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des aktuellen Abrechnungszeitraums deaktiviert wird. Die Verlängerungsgebühr wird bis zu 24 Stunden vor Ablauf deines aktiven Zeitraums verarbeitet. Du kannst dein Abonnement jederzeit über die Seite „Abos“ in den Kontoeinstellungen des Google Play Store verwalten oder kündigen. Wenn du kündigst, behältst du den vollen Zugriff auf alle Abo-Vorteile bis zum Ende des aktuellen Abrechnungszeitraums. Für den laufenden Abrechnungszeitraum werden keine Teilrückerstattungen gewährt; es gilt die offizielle Rückerstattungsrichtlinie von Google Play. Die Kündigung wird erst wirksam, wenn der aktuelle Abo-Zeitraum endet.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.en: These are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Google Play account upon purchase confirmation. Your subscription will renew automatically unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of your current billing cycle. Renewal charges will be processed up to 24 hours prior to the expiration of your active period. You may manage or cancel your subscription at any time via your Subscriptions page in Google Play Store account settings. If you cancel, you will retain full access to all subscription benefits until the end of the current billing cycle. No partial refunds will be issued for the ongoing billing period, subject to Google Play's official refund policy. Cancellation will only take effect once your current subscription period ends.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.es: Estas son suscripciones con renovación automática. El pago se cargará a tu cuenta de Google Play al confirmar la compra. Tu suscripción se renovará automáticamente a menos que la renovación automática se desactive al menos 24 horas antes de que termine tu ciclo de facturación actual. El cargo de la renovación se procesa hasta 24 horas antes de que venza tu periodo activo. Puedes administrar o cancelar tu suscripción en cualquier momento desde la página Suscripciones en la configuración de tu cuenta de Google Play. Si cancelas, conservarás el acceso completo a todos los beneficios de la suscripción hasta el final del ciclo de facturación actual. No se emitirán reembolsos parciales por el periodo de facturación en curso, sujeto a la política oficial de reembolsos de Google Play. La cancelación solo se aplicará una vez que finalice tu periodo de suscripción actual.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.fr: Ce sont des abonnements à renouvellement automatique. Le paiement sera prélevé sur ton compte Google Play après confirmation de l'achat. Ton abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin du cycle de facturation en cours. Les frais de renouvellement sont traités jusqu'à 24 heures avant l'expiration de ta période active. Tu peux gérer ou résilier ton abonnement à tout moment depuis la page « Abonnements » dans les paramètres de ton compte du Google Play Store. Si tu résilies, tu conserves l'accès complet à tous les avantages de l'abonnement jusqu'à la fin du cycle de facturation en cours. Aucun remboursement partiel ne sera accordé pour la période de facturation en cours, conformément à la politique de remboursement officielle de Google Play. La résiliation ne prend effet qu'à la fin de ta période d'abonnement en cours.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.hi: ये ऑटो-रिन्यू होने वाली सदस्यताएँ हैं। खरीदारी की पुष्टि के बाद भुगतान आपके Google Play खाते से काटा जाएगा। अगर मौजूदा बिलिंग साइकल खत्म होने से कम से कम 24 घंटे पहले ऑटो-रिन्यूअल बंद नहीं किया जाता, तो आपकी सदस्यता अपने आप रिन्यू हो जाएगी। रिन्यूअल का शुल्क आपकी मौजूदा अवधि खत्म होने से 24 घंटे पहले तक प्रोसेस किया जाएगा। आप Google Play Store की खाता सेटिंग में सदस्यताएं पेज से कभी भी अपनी सदस्यता मैनेज या रद्द कर सकते हैं। रद्द करने पर भी आप मौजूदा बिलिंग साइकल खत्म होने तक सदस्यता के सभी फ़ायदे पूरी तरह इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं। चल रही बिलिंग अवधि के लिए कोई आंशिक रिफ़ंड नहीं दिया जाएगा; इस पर Google Play की आधिकारिक रिफ़ंड नीति लागू होगी। रद्द करना आपकी मौजूदा सदस्यता अवधि खत्म होने के बाद ही लागू होगा।
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.id: Ini adalah langganan dengan perpanjangan otomatis. Pembayaran akan ditagihkan ke akun Google Play kamu setelah pembelian dikonfirmasi. Langganan kamu akan diperpanjang secara otomatis kecuali perpanjangan otomatis dimatikan setidaknya 24 jam sebelum siklus penagihan saat ini berakhir. Biaya perpanjangan diproses hingga 24 jam sebelum periode aktif kamu berakhir. Kamu dapat mengelola atau membatalkan langganan kapan saja melalui halaman Langganan di pengaturan akun Google Play Store. Jika kamu membatalkan, kamu tetap memiliki akses penuh ke seluruh manfaat langganan sampai siklus penagihan saat ini berakhir. Tidak ada pengembalian dana sebagian untuk periode penagihan yang sedang berjalan, sesuai kebijakan pengembalian dana resmi Google Play. Pembatalan baru berlaku setelah periode langganan kamu saat ini berakhir.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.it: Questi sono abbonamenti con rinnovo automatico. Il pagamento verrà addebitato sul tuo account Google Play alla conferma dell'acquisto. L'abbonamento si rinnoverà automaticamente a meno che il rinnovo automatico non venga disattivato almeno 24 ore prima della fine del ciclo di fatturazione in corso. L'addebito per il rinnovo verrà elaborato fino a 24 ore prima della scadenza del periodo attivo. Puoi gestire o annullare l'abbonamento in qualsiasi momento dalla pagina Abbonamenti nelle impostazioni del tuo account Google Play Store. Se annulli, conserverai l'accesso completo a tutti i vantaggi dell'abbonamento fino alla fine del ciclo di fatturazione in corso. Non sono previsti rimborsi parziali per il periodo di fatturazione in corso, fatta salva la politica ufficiale di rimborso di Google Play. L'annullamento avrà effetto solo al termine del periodo di abbonamento in corso.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.ja: これらは自動更新されるサブスクリプションです。購入確定後、お客様の Google Play アカウントから料金が請求されます。現在の請求期間終了の 24 時間以上前に自動更新をオフにしない限り、サブスクリプションは自動的に更新されます。更新料金は、有効期間の終了前 24 時間以内に処理されます。サブスクリプションの管理や解約は、Google Play ストアのアカウント設定内の「定期購入」ページからいつでも行えます。解約後も、現在の請求期間が終了するまではすべてのサブスクリプション特典をそのままご利用いただけます。進行中の請求期間について日割りでの返金は行われず、Google Play の公式返金ポリシーが適用されます。解約は現在のサブスクリプション期間が終了した時点で有効になります。
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.ko: 본 상품은 자동 갱신 구독입니다. 구매를 확인하면 회원님의 Google Play 계정으로 요금이 청구됩니다. 현재 결제 주기가 끝나기 최소 24시간 전에 자동 갱신을 해제하지 않으면 구독이 자동으로 갱신됩니다. 갱신 요금은 이용 기간이 만료되기 24시간 이내에 처리됩니다. Google Play 스토어 계정 설정의 정기 결제 페이지에서 언제든지 구독을 관리하거나 해지할 수 있습니다. 해지한 경우에도 현재 결제 주기가 끝날 때까지 모든 구독 혜택을 그대로 이용할 수 있습니다. 진행 중인 결제 기간에 대한 부분 환불은 제공되지 않으며, Google Play의 공식 환불 정책이 적용됩니다. 해지는 현재 구독 기간이 끝난 후에만 적용됩니다.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.pt: Estas são assinaturas com renovação automática. O pagamento será cobrado na sua conta do Google Play após a confirmação da compra. Sua assinatura será renovada automaticamente, a menos que a renovação automática seja desativada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do ciclo de cobrança atual. A cobrança da renovação será processada até 24 horas antes do término do período ativo. Você pode gerenciar ou cancelar sua assinatura a qualquer momento na página "Assinaturas" nos ajustes da sua conta na Google Play Store. Se você cancelar, continuará com acesso total a todos os benefícios da assinatura até o fim do ciclo de cobrança atual. Não haverá reembolso parcial do período de cobrança em andamento, conforme a política oficial de reembolso do Google Play. O cancelamento só entra em vigor após o término do período de assinatura atual.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.ru: Это подписки с автоматическим продлением. Оплата будет списана с твоего аккаунта Google Play после подтверждения покупки. Подписка продлевается автоматически, если автопродление не отключено минимум за 24 часа до конца текущего расчётного периода. Плата за продление списывается не позднее чем за 24 часа до окончания активного периода. Ты можешь в любой момент управлять подпиской или отменить её на странице «Подписки» в настройках аккаунта Google Play Маркета. После отмены все преимущества подписки остаются полностью доступны до конца текущего расчётного периода. Частичный возврат средств за текущий расчётный период не производится; действует официальная политика возврата средств Google Play. Отмена вступает в силу только после окончания текущего периода подписки.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.th: สินค้าเหล่านี้เป็นการสมัครใช้บริการแบบต่ออายุอัตโนมัติ ระบบจะเรียกเก็บเงินจากบัญชี Google Play ของคุณเมื่อยืนยันการซื้อ การสมัครใช้บริการของคุณจะต่ออายุอัตโนมัติ เว้นแต่มีการปิดการต่ออายุอัตโนมัติอย่างน้อย 24 ชั่วโมงก่อนสิ้นสุดรอบการเรียกเก็บเงินปัจจุบัน ระบบจะดำเนินการเรียกเก็บค่าต่ออายุภายใน 24 ชั่วโมงก่อนสิ้นสุดระยะเวลาที่ใช้งานอยู่ คุณสามารถจัดการหรือยกเลิกการสมัครใช้บริการได้ตลอดเวลาที่หน้าการสมัครใช้บริการในการตั้งค่าบัญชีของ Google Play หากคุณยกเลิก คุณยังสามารถใช้สิทธิประโยชน์ทั้งหมดของการสมัครใช้บริการได้จนถึงวันสิ้นสุดรอบการเรียกเก็บเงินปัจจุบัน ทั้งนี้จะไม่มีการคืนเงินบางส่วนสำหรับรอบการเรียกเก็บเงินที่กำลังดำเนินอยู่ โดยเป็นไปตามนโยบายการคืนเงินอย่างเป็นทางการของ Google Play การยกเลิกจะมีผลเมื่อรอบการสมัครใช้บริการปัจจุบันของคุณสิ้นสุดลงแล้วเท่านั้น
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.tr: Bunlar otomatik yenilenen aboneliklerdir. Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Google Play hesabınızdan tahsil edilir. Mevcut faturalandırma döneminizin bitiminden en az 24 saat önce otomatik yenileme kapatılmadığı sürece aboneliğiniz otomatik olarak yenilenir. Yenileme ücreti, etkin döneminizin bitiminden en fazla 24 saat önce işleme alınır. Aboneliğinizi dilediğiniz zaman Google Play hesap ayarlarındaki Abonelikler sayfasından yönetebilir veya iptal edebilirsiniz. İptal etmeniz durumunda mevcut faturalandırma döneminin sonuna kadar tüm abonelik ayrıcalıklarına tam erişiminiz devam eder. Devam eden faturalandırma dönemi için kısmi geri ödeme yapılmaz; Google Play'in resmi geri ödeme politikası geçerlidir. İptal, yalnızca mevcut abonelik döneminiz sona erdikten sonra geçerli olur.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.vi: Đây là các gói đăng ký tự động gia hạn. Khoản thanh toán sẽ được trừ vào tài khoản Google Play của bạn sau khi bạn xác nhận mua. Gói đăng ký của bạn sẽ tự động gia hạn, trừ khi tính năng tự động gia hạn được tắt ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi chu kỳ thanh toán hiện tại kết thúc. Phí gia hạn sẽ được xử lý trong vòng 24 giờ trước khi thời hạn đang hoạt động của bạn hết hiệu lực. Bạn có thể quản lý hoặc hủy gói đăng ký bất cứ lúc nào tại trang Gói thuê bao trong phần cài đặt tài khoản Google Play. Nếu bạn hủy, bạn vẫn được sử dụng đầy đủ toàn bộ đặc quyền của gói đăng ký cho đến khi chu kỳ thanh toán hiện tại kết thúc. Chúng tôi không hoàn lại một phần khoản phí của chu kỳ thanh toán đang diễn ra, và việc hoàn tiền tuân theo chính sách hoàn tiền chính thức của Google Play. Việc hủy chỉ có hiệu lực sau khi chu kỳ đăng ký hiện tại của bạn kết thúc.
These are auto-renewing subscriptions. P.zh: 本商品为自动续期订阅。确认购买后，将通过你的 Google Play 账户扣款。除非在当前计费周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续期，订阅将自动续订。系统会在当前有效期到期前 24 小时内处理续订扣款。你可随时在 Google Play 商店账户设置的「订阅」页面中管理或取消订阅。取消后，你仍可继续使用全部会员权益直至当前计费周期结束。当前计费周期不提供按比例退款，具体以 Google Play 官方退款政策为准。取消仅在当前订阅周期结束后生效。

These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.ar:
هذه العناصر عبارة عن اشتراكات ذات تجديد تلقائي. سيتم خصم المبلغ من حساب Apple ID الخاص بك بعد تأكيد الشراء. يتم تجديد الاشتراك تلقائيًا ما لم يتم إيقاف التجديد التلقائي قبل 24 ساعة على الأقل من نهاية الفترة الحالية. سيتم خصم رسوم التجديد من حسابك خلال 24 ساعة السابقة لنهاية الفترة الحالية. بعد الشراء، يمكنك إدارة الاشتراك وإيقاف التجديد التلقائي من إعدادات حسابك في App Store.
إذا ألغيت اشتراكك، فلن يتم رد أي مبالغ عن دورة الفوترة الحالية، ويمكنك الاستمرار في الاستفادة من جميع مزايا الاشتراك حتى نهاية الفترة الحالية. لا يصبح الإلغاء ساريًا إلا بعد انتهاء فترة اشتراكك الحالية.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.de:
Bei diesen Käufen handelt es sich um automatisch verlängerbare Abonnements. Die Zahlung wird nach Bestätigung des Kaufs über dein Apple-ID-Konto abgebucht. Das Abonnement verlängert sich automatisch, sofern die automatische Verlängerung nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des aktuellen Zeitraums deaktiviert wird. Die Gebühr für die Verlängerung wird innerhalb von 24 Stunden vor Ende des aktuellen Zeitraums von deinem Konto abgebucht. Nach dem Kauf kannst du das Abonnement in den Einstellungen deines Accounts im App Store verwalten und die automatische Verlängerung deaktivieren.
Wenn du dein Abonnement kündigst, wird der aktuelle Abrechnungszeitraum nicht zurückerstattet und du kannst alle Abo-Vorteile bis zum Ende des aktuellen Zeitraums weiter nutzen. Die Kündigung wird erst wirksam, wenn der aktuelle Abo-Zeitraum abgelaufen ist.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.en:
These purchases are auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and turn off auto-renewal of the subscription by accessing your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
If you cancel your subscription, no refund will be issued for the current billing cycle, and you may keep accessing all subscription benefits until the end of your current period. Cancellation will only take effect once your current subscription period expires.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.es:
Estas compras son suscripciones con renovación automática. El pago se cargará a tu cuenta de Apple ID al confirmar la compra. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente a menos que la renovación automática se desactive al menos 24 horas antes de que termine el periodo actual. Se cobrará la renovación en tu cuenta dentro de las 24 horas previas al final del periodo actual. Después de la compra, puedes administrar y desactivar la renovación automática de la suscripción en la configuración de tu cuenta en el App Store.
Si cancelas tu suscripción, no se emitirán reembolsos por el ciclo de facturación actual y podrás seguir disfrutando de todos los beneficios de la suscripción hasta el final de tu periodo actual. La cancelación solo se aplicará una vez que finalice tu periodo de suscripción actual.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.fr:
Ces achats sont des abonnements à renouvellement automatique. Le paiement sera prélevé sur ton compte identifiant Apple après confirmation de l'achat. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Les frais de renouvellement sont prélevés sur ton compte dans les 24 heures précédant la fin de la période en cours. Après l'achat, tu peux gérer ton abonnement et désactiver le renouvellement automatique dans les réglages de ton compte sur l'App Store.
Si tu résilies ton abonnement, aucun remboursement ne sera accordé pour le cycle de facturation en cours, et tu conserves l'accès à tous les avantages de l'abonnement jusqu'à la fin de la période en cours. La résiliation ne prend effet qu'à l'expiration de ta période d'abonnement en cours.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.hi:
ये खरीदारियाँ ऑटो-रिन्यू होने वाली सदस्यताएँ हैं। खरीदारी की पुष्टि के बाद भुगतान आपके Apple ID खाते से काटा जाएगा। अगर मौजूदा अवधि खत्म होने से कम से कम 24 घंटे पहले ऑटो-रिन्यूअल बंद नहीं किया जाता, तो सदस्यता अपने आप रिन्यू हो जाएगी। रिन्यूअल का शुल्क मौजूदा अवधि खत्म होने से 24 घंटे के अंदर आपके खाते से लिया जाएगा। खरीदारी के बाद आप App Store में अपने खाते की सेटिंग्ज़ में जाकर सदस्यता का ऑटो-रिन्यूअल मैनेज कर सकते हैं या बंद कर सकते हैं।
सदस्यता रद्द करने पर मौजूदा बिलिंग साइकल के लिए कोई रिफ़ंड नहीं मिलेगा और आप मौजूदा अवधि खत्म होने तक सदस्यता के सभी फ़ायदे इस्तेमाल करते रह सकते हैं। रद्द करना आपकी मौजूदा सदस्यता अवधि खत्म होने के बाद ही लागू होगा।
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.id:
Pembelian ini adalah langganan dengan perpanjangan otomatis. Pembayaran akan ditagihkan ke akun ID Apple kamu setelah pembelian dikonfirmasi. Langganan diperpanjang secara otomatis kecuali perpanjangan otomatis dimatikan setidaknya 24 jam sebelum periode saat ini berakhir. Biaya perpanjangan akan ditagihkan ke akun kamu dalam 24 jam sebelum periode saat ini berakhir. Setelah pembelian, kamu dapat mengelola dan mematikan perpanjangan otomatis langganan di pengaturan akunmu pada App Store.
Jika kamu membatalkan langganan, tidak ada pengembalian dana untuk siklus penagihan saat ini, dan kamu tetap dapat menikmati seluruh manfaat langganan sampai periode saat ini berakhir. Pembatalan baru berlaku setelah periode langganan kamu saat ini berakhir.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.it:
Questi acquisti sono abbonamenti con rinnovo automatico. Il pagamento verrà addebitato sul tuo account Apple ID alla conferma dell'acquisto. L'abbonamento si rinnova automaticamente a meno che il rinnovo automatico non venga disattivato almeno 24 ore prima della fine del periodo in corso. L'addebito per il rinnovo avverrà entro le 24 ore precedenti la fine del periodo in corso. Dopo l'acquisto puoi gestire e disattivare il rinnovo automatico dell'abbonamento nelle impostazioni del tuo account sull'App Store.
Se annulli l'abbonamento, non è previsto alcun rimborso per il ciclo di fatturazione in corso e potrai continuare a usare tutti i vantaggi dell'abbonamento fino alla fine del periodo attuale. L'annullamento avrà effetto solo alla scadenza del periodo di abbonamento in corso.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.ja:
これらの商品は自動更新されるサブスクリプションです。購入確定後、お客様の Apple ID アカウントから料金が請求されます。現在の期間終了の 24 時間以上前に自動更新をオフにしない限り、サブスクリプションは自動的に更新されます。更新料金は、現在の期間終了前 24 時間以内にアカウントに請求されます。購入後は、App Store のアカウント設定からサブスクリプションの管理と自動更新のオフができます。
サブスクリプションを解約しても、現在の請求期間分の返金は行われません。現在の期間が終了するまではすべてのサブスクリプション特典を引き続きご利用いただけます。解約は現在のサブスクリプション期間が終了した時点で有効になります。
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.ko:
본 상품은 자동 갱신 구독입니다. 구매를 확인하면 회원님의 Apple ID 계정으로 요금이 청구됩니다. 현재 기간이 끝나기 최소 24시간 전에 자동 갱신을 해제하지 않으면 구독이 자동으로 갱신됩니다. 갱신 요금은 현재 기간이 끝나기 24시간 이내에 계정으로 청구됩니다. 구매 후에는 App Store의 계정 설정에서 구독을 관리하고 자동 갱신을 해제할 수 있습니다.
구독을 해지해도 현재 결제 주기에 대한 환불은 제공되지 않으며, 현재 기간이 끝날 때까지 모든 구독 혜택을 계속 이용할 수 있습니다. 해지는 현재 구독 기간이 만료된 후에만 적용됩니다.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.pt:
Estas compras são assinaturas com renovação automática. O pagamento será cobrado na sua conta do Apple ID após a confirmação da compra. A assinatura é renovada automaticamente, a menos que a renovação automática seja desativada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual. A cobrança da renovação será feita nas 24 horas anteriores ao fim do período atual. Após a compra, você pode gerenciar e desativar a renovação automática nos ajustes da sua conta na App Store.
Se você cancelar a assinatura, não haverá reembolso do ciclo de cobrança atual e você continuará com acesso a todos os benefícios da assinatura até o fim do período atual. O cancelamento só entra em vigor após o término do período de assinatura atual.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.ru:
Эти покупки являются подписками с автоматическим продлением. Оплата будет списана с твоего аккаунта Apple ID после подтверждения покупки. Подписка продлевается автоматически, если автопродление не отключено минимум за 24 часа до конца текущего периода. Плата за продление списывается с аккаунта в течение 24 часов до окончания текущего периода. После покупки ты можешь управлять подпиской и отключить автопродление в настройках своего аккаунта в App Store.
При отмене подписки средства за текущий расчётный период не возвращаются, а все преимущества подписки остаются доступны до конца текущего периода. Отмена вступает в силу только после окончания текущего периода подписки.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.th:
สินค้าเหล่านี้เป็นการสมัครใช้บริการแบบต่ออายุอัตโนมัติ ระบบจะเรียกเก็บเงินจากบัญชี Apple ID ของคุณเมื่อยืนยันการซื้อ การสมัครใช้บริการจะต่ออายุอัตโนมัติ เว้นแต่มีการปิดการต่ออายุอัตโนมัติอย่างน้อย 24 ชั่วโมงก่อนสิ้นสุดรอบปัจจุบัน ระบบจะเรียกเก็บค่าต่ออายุจากบัญชีของคุณภายใน 24 ชั่วโมงก่อนสิ้นสุดรอบปัจจุบัน หลังจากการซื้อ คุณสามารถจัดการและปิดการต่ออายุอัตโนมัติของการสมัครใช้บริการได้ในการตั้งค่าบัญชีของคุณบน App Store
หากคุณยกเลิกการสมัครใช้บริการ จะไม่มีการคืนเงินสำหรับรอบการเรียกเก็บเงินปัจจุบัน และคุณยังสามารถใช้สิทธิประโยชน์ทั้งหมดของการสมัครใช้บริการได้จนถึงวันสิ้นสุดรอบปัจจุบัน การยกเลิกจะมีผลเมื่อรอบการสมัครใช้บริการปัจจุบันของคุณสิ้นสุดลงแล้วเท่านั้น
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.tr:
Bu satın alımlar otomatik yenilenen aboneliklerdir. Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple ID hesabınızdan tahsil edilir. Mevcut dönemin bitiminden en az 24 saat önce otomatik yenileme kapatılmadığı sürece abonelik otomatik olarak yenilenir. Yenileme ücreti, mevcut dönemin bitiminden önceki 24 saat içinde hesabınızdan tahsil edilir. Satın alma sonrasında aboneliğin otomatik yenilenmesini App Store'daki hesap ayarlarınızdan yönetebilir ve kapatabilirsiniz.
Aboneliğinizi iptal ederseniz mevcut faturalandırma dönemi için geri ödeme yapılmaz ve mevcut döneminizin sonuna kadar tüm abonelik ayrıcalıklarını kullanmaya devam edebilirsiniz. İptal, yalnızca mevcut abonelik döneminiz sona erdikten sonra geçerli olur.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.vi:
Các giao dịch này là gói đăng ký tự động gia hạn. Khoản thanh toán sẽ được trừ vào tài khoản Apple ID của bạn sau khi bạn xác nhận mua. Gói đăng ký sẽ tự động gia hạn, trừ khi tính năng tự động gia hạn được tắt ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi chu kỳ hiện tại kết thúc. Phí gia hạn sẽ được trừ vào tài khoản của bạn trong vòng 24 giờ trước khi chu kỳ hiện tại kết thúc. Sau khi mua, bạn có thể quản lý và tắt tính năng tự động gia hạn của gói đăng ký trong phần cài đặt tài khoản của bạn trên App Store.
Nếu bạn hủy gói đăng ký, khoản phí của chu kỳ thanh toán hiện tại sẽ không được hoàn lại và bạn vẫn có thể sử dụng toàn bộ đặc quyền của gói đăng ký cho đến khi chu kỳ hiện tại kết thúc. Việc hủy chỉ có hiệu lực sau khi chu kỳ đăng ký hiện tại của bạn hết hạn.
These purchases are auto-renewable subsc.zh:
本商品为自动续期订阅。确认购买后，将通过你的 Apple ID 账户扣款。除非在当前周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续期，订阅将自动续订。系统会在当前周期结束前 24 小时内为你扣取续订费用。购买后，你可在 App Store 的账户设置中管理并关闭自动续期。
取消订阅后，当前计费周期内的费用不予退还，你仍可继续使用全部会员权益直至当前周期结束。取消仅在当前订阅周期到期后生效。

We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.ar:
يؤسفنا أنك تريد حذف حساب اللعبة الخاص بك.
يرجى ملاحظة أن حذف الحساب يزيل نهائيًا جميع البيانات المرتبطة به، بما في ذلك المراحل والتلميحات والتحديد، دون أي إمكانية للاستعادة.
إذا كنت متأكدًا، فاضغط على «حذف الحساب» أدناه.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.de:
Es tut uns leid, dass du dein Spielkonto löschen möchtest.
Bitte beachte: Beim Löschen werden alle zugehörigen Daten dauerhaft entfernt, einschließlich Level, Tipps und Ortungen – eine Wiederherstellung ist nicht möglich.
Wenn du sicher bist, tippe unten auf „Konto löschen“.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.en:
We're sorry to hear you want to delete your game account.
Please note that deleting your account will permanently remove all associated data, including levels, hints, locates, with no recovery option.
If you're sure, tap "Delete Account" below.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.es:
Lamentamos que quieras eliminar tu cuenta del juego.
Ten en cuenta que al eliminarla se borrarán permanentemente todos los datos asociados, incluidos niveles, pistas y localizar, sin opción de recuperarlos.
Si estás seguro, toca «Eliminar cuenta» abajo.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.fr:
Nous sommes désolés que tu veuilles supprimer ton compte de jeu.
Note que la suppression effacera définitivement toutes les données associées, y compris les niveaux, les indices et la localisation, sans possibilité de récupération.
Si tu es sûr, appuie sur « Supprimer le compte » ci-dessous.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.hi:
हमें खेद है कि आप अपना गेम खाता हटाना चाहते हैं।
ध्यान दें कि खाता हटाने से सभी संबंधित डेटा स्थायी रूप से हट जाएगा, जिसमें लेवल, संकेत और लोकेट शामिल हैं, और उसे वापस नहीं पाया जा सकता।
अगर आप निश्चित हैं, तो नीचे «खाता हटाएँ» दबाएँ।
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.id:
Kami menyesal kamu ingin menghapus akun game-mu.
Perlu diketahui bahwa menghapus akun akan menghilangkan semua data terkait secara permanen, termasuk level, petunjuk dan pelacakan, tanpa opsi pemulihan.
Jika kamu yakin, ketuk «Hapus akun» di bawah.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.it:
Ci dispiace che tu voglia eliminare il tuo account di gioco.
Ricorda che l'eliminazione rimuove definitivamente tutti i dati associati, inclusi livelli, suggerimenti e localizza, senza possibilità di recupero.
Se sei sicuro, tocca «Elimina account» qui sotto.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.ja:
ゲームアカウントを削除されるのは残念です。
アカウントを削除すると、レベル・ヒント・位置表示を含む関連データすべてが永久に削除され、復元できませんのでご注意ください。
よろしければ、下の「アカウント削除」をタップしてください。
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.ko:
게임 계정을 삭제하려 하셔서 아쉽습니다.
계정을 삭제하면 레벨, 힌트, 위치 표시를 포함한 모든 관련 데이터가 영구적으로 삭제되며 복구할 수 없습니다.
확실하다면 아래의 「계정 삭제」를 누르세요.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.pt:
Lamentamos que você queira excluir sua conta do jogo.
Observe que excluir a conta remove permanentemente todos os dados associados, incluindo fases, dicas e localizar, sem opção de recuperação.
Se tiver certeza, toque em «Excluir conta» abaixo.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.ru:
Нам жаль, что ты хочешь удалить игровой аккаунт.
Обрати внимание: удаление безвозвратно уберёт все связанные данные, включая уровни, подсказки и поиски, без возможности восстановления.
Если ты уверен, нажми «Удалить аккаунт» ниже.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.th:
เราเสียใจที่คุณต้องการลบบัญชีเกมของคุณ
โปรดทราบว่าการลบบัญชีจะลบข้อมูลที่เกี่ยวข้องทั้งหมด อย่างถาวร รวมถึงด่าน คำใบ้ และการระบุตำแหน่ง โดยไม่สามารถกู้คืนได้
หากคุณแน่ใจ โปรดกด «ลบบัญชี» ด้านล่าง
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.tr:
Oyun hesabını silmek istediğin için üzgünüz.
Hesabı silmenin, bölümler, ipuçları ve konum bulma dahil ilgili tüm verileri kalıcı olarak kaldıracağını ve geri alma imkânı olmadığını unutma.
Eminsen aşağıdaki «Hesabı sil» düğmesine dokun.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.vi:
Chúng tôi rất tiếc khi bạn muốn xóa tài khoản trò chơi.
Lưu ý rằng việc xóa tài khoản sẽ xóa vĩnh viễn toàn bộ dữ liệu liên quan, bao gồm màn, gợi ý và định vị, và không thể phục hồi.
Nếu bạn đã chắc chắn, hãy nhấn «Xóa tài khoản» bên dưới.
We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.zh:
很遗憾你想删除游戏账号。
请注意，删除账号会永久移除所有相关数据，包括关卡进度、提示道具、定位道具，且无法恢复。
如果确定，请点击下方的「删除账号」。

We're sorry to hear you want to delete y.zh: 很遗憾你想注销游戏账号。{br}请注意：注销后与账号关联的全部数据将被永久删除，包括关卡进度、提示道具、定位道具，且无法恢复。{br}如已确认，请点击下方的「注销账号」。

We've made a few adjustments to improve.es: Hicimos algunos ajustes para mejorar tu experiencia. ¡Gracias por tu apoyo!
We've made a few adjustments to improve.fr: Nous avons apporté quelques ajustements pour améliorer votre expérience. Merci de votre soutien !
We've made a few adjustments to improve.hi: आपके अनुभव को बेहतर बनाने के लिए हमने कुछ बदलाव किए हैं। आपके समर्थन के लिए धन्यवाद!
